cūrṇisū0-chabbīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭa antarakāla sādhika do chayāsaṭha sāgaropama hai ||56||
viśepārtha-isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki aṭṭhāīsa aura sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktiyokā jo utkṛṣṭa kāla pahale batalāyā gayā hai, vahī chabbīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭa antarakāla mānā gayā hai | ataḥ chabbīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭa antarakāla sādhika do bāra chayāsaṭha arthāt ekasau battīsa sāgarase kucha adhika hotā hai |
cūrṇisū0-sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā kitanā antarakāla hai ? jaghanya antarakāla palyopamakā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga hai ||97|| ' viśeṣārtha-sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktivālā koī mithyādṛṣṭi jīva upaśamasamyaktvako grahaṇakara aura aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktivālā hokara antarako prāpta huā| punaḥ mithyātvame jākara sarvajaghanya udvelanākālake dvārā samyaktvaprakṛtikī udvelanā karake sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhakti karanevālā ho gayā| isa prakāra. isa jīvake palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa jaghanya antarakāla pāyā jātā hai|

[2 prakṛtivibhakti 98. ukkasseṇa uvaḍḍapoggalapariyaṭṭa | 99. aṭṭhāvīsavihattiyassa jahaṇṇeṇa egasamao | 100. ukasseṇa uvaḍḍapoggalapariyaṭṭa |
cūrṇisū0-sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭa antarakāla upādhaṃ pudgalaparivartana hai ||98||
viśeṣārtha-koī anādi mithyādṛṣṭi jīva ardhapudgalaparivartanakālake prathama samayame samyaktvako grahaṇakara yathākramase sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhakti karanevālā huā| tatpaścāt samyagmithyātvaprakṛtikī bhī udvelanākara antarako prāpta huā| jaba upāpudgalaparivartanakālameṃ sarvajaghanya palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa kāla śeṣa rahā, tava upaśamasamyaktvako grahaṇa kara aura usake sātha antarmuhūrta kāla vitākara mithyātvako prāpta huā | tatpaścāt samyaktvaprakṛtike udvelanākālame sarvajaghanya antarmuhūrtakāla śepa rahā, taba samyaktvake sanmukha ho, antarakaraṇa karake aura mithyātvakī prathama sthitike dvicarama samayameṃ samyaktvaprakṛtikī udvelanākara antima samayame sattāīsa prakṛtiyoṃkī vibhakti karanevālā hokara kramase siddhiko prāpta huā| aise jīvake pahaleke palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa kālase tathā antima
antarmuhūrtakālase kama ardhapudgalaparivartanapramāṇa utkṛṣṭa antarakāla sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā pāyā jātā hai| ,
cūrṇisū0-aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā jaghanya antarakāla eka samaya hai|99||
viśeṣārtha-aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktivālā koī mithyādṛṣṭi jīva, samyaktvaprakṛtike udvelanākālame antarmuhūrta śeṣa raha jānepara upaśamasamyaktvake abhimukha ho antarakaraṇa karake aura mithyātvakī prathama sthitike dvicarama samayame samyaktvaprakṛtikī udvelanā kara antima samayame sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhakti karanevālā huā| tadanantara samayame usane upaśamasamyaktvako grahaṇakara aṭṭhāisa prakṛtiyo kā sattva utpanna kiyā, taba usa jīvake aṭṭhāisa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā eka samayapramāṇa jaghanya antarakāla upalabdha huā |
cūrṇisū0-aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭakāla upārdhapudgala parivartana hai ||100||
viśeṣārtha-kisī anādi mithyādṛṣṭi jīvane ardhapudgala parivartanake ādi samayame upaśamasamyaktvako grahaṇa kiyā aura aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhakti karanevālā huā| isa prakāra aṭṭhāīsa vibhaktikā ārambha kara aura sarvajaghanya palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa kālake dvārā samyaktvaprakṛtikī udvelanā kara sattāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhakti karanevālā huā
aura antarako prāpta ho ardhapudgalaparivartanakāla taka saṃsārame paribhramaṇa kara antame sarvajaghanya antarmuhūrtapramāṇa saṃsārake avaśepa raha jāne para upaśamasamyaktvako grahaṇa kara aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī vibhaktivālā hokara kramaśaḥ antarmuhūrtakālase siddha ho gayā | isa prakāra pūrvake palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgase aura antake antarmuhūrtakālase kama ardhapudgalaparivartanapramāṇa aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyoī vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭa antara kāla pāyā jātā hai|

sthitivibhakti-anuyogadvāra - nirūpaṇa
vāle jīva sarva jīvoke anantave bhāga hai aura anutkṛṣṭa tathā ajaghanya sthitike bandhaka jīva anantabahubhāga hai, aisā jānanā cāhie |
'parimāṇa prarūpaṇā - isa anuyogadvāra meṃ eka samaya ke bhītara karmoṃ kī utkṛṣṭa, anutkṛṣṭa, jaghanya aura ajaghanya sthitike bandha karanevāle jīvoke parimāṇakā vicāra kiyā gayā hai | jaise - eka samayame mohakarmakī utkṛṣṭa sthitike vibhaktivāle jīva asaṃkhyāta hai | anutkṛṣṭa sthitike vibhaktivāle jīva ananta hai | jaghanya sthitikī vibhaktivāle jīva saṃkhyāta hai aura ajaghanya sthitikī vibhaktivāle jīva ananta hai | isa prakārase sarva mūlakarma aura unakī uttaraprakṛtiyokī vibhaktivāle jīvoke parimāṇakā varṇana isa parimāṇaanuyogadvāra se kiyā gayā hai | kṣetra prarūpaṇā - isa anuyogadvārame utkṛṣṭa sthitibandhake bandhaka jīva kitane kṣetrame rahate hai, anutkṛṣṭa sthitike bandhaka jīva kitane kṣetrame rahate haiṃ aura jaghanya- ajaghanya sthiti ke bandhaka jīva kitane kṣetrame rahate haiṃ, isa bātakā vicāra kiyā gayā hai | prakṛtame mohanīyakarma vivakṣita hai, ataḥ usakī utkṛṣṭa sthitivibhaktivāle jīva lokake asaṃkhyātave bhāgame rahate hai aura anutkṛṣṭa sthitivibhaktivāle jīva sarvalokame rahate hai | isī prakārase jaghanya aura ajaghanya sthitivibhaktivāle jīvokā kṣetra jānanā cāhie | isa prakārase sarva mūla karmoṃ aura unakī uttaraprakṛtiyo ke vartamānakālika kṣetrako varṇana isa anuyogadvāra me kiyā gayā hai |

sannikarṣa prarūpaṇā - mohakarmakī vivakṣita prakṛti ke utkṛṣṭavandhakā karanevālā jīva anyaprakṛtiyokā kyā utkṛṣṭabandha karatā hai, athavā kyā anutkṛṣṭavandha karatā hai, isa prakāra se eka prakṛtikī utkṛṣṭasthitike bandhakake sātha dūsarī prakṛtikī utkṛṣṭa anutkṛṣṭa ādi sthiti ke bandhakakā vicāra kiyā gayā hai | jaise- midhyātvakī utkṛṣṭasthitikā vandha karanevālā jīva solaha kaṣāya, napuṃsakaveda, arati, śoka, bhaya aura jugupsākā niyamase bandha karanevālā hotā hai | kintu vaha unakā utkṛṣṭavandha bhī karatā hai, aura anutkṛṣṭavandha bhī karatā hai | yadi utkṛṣṭa - bandha karatā hai, to use utkṛṣṭasthitibandhameṃse eka samaya kamase lekara palyake asaṃkhyātave bhāga kama taka bā~dhatā hai | isa prakārase mohakarmakī śeṣa prakṛtiyoke sātha bhī midhyātvake utkṛṣṭaanutkṛṣṭa sthitibandhakā vicāra kiyā gayā hai | mohakarmakī prakṛtiyo ke samāna hī śepa karmoṃkī

bhāvārūpaṇā-bhāvānugamakī apekṣā kisī bhī mūlakarma yā unakī uttaraprakṛtiyokī utkṛṣṭha-anutkṛṣṭa aura javanya-ajaghanya sthitivibhaktivāle sarvajīvoke ekamātra audayikabhāva pāyā jātā hai|

bhujākāra-anuyogadvārame bhujākāra, alpatara aura avasthita ina tīnokā vicāra kiyā jātā hai | jo jīva kama sthitise adhika sthitiko prāpta ho, use bhujākāra sthitivibhaktivālā kahate hai | jo adhika sthitise kama sthitiko prāpta ho, use alpatara sthitivibhaktivālā kahate hai aura jisakī pahale samayake samāna dūsare samayame sthiti rahe, use avasthita-sthitivibhaktivālā kahate hai | isa prakāra mohanīyakarmakī tīno prakārakī sthitivāle sakhejadibhāgahīṇa vā, sakhejaguṇahīṇa vā | (mahāba0) | ettha mūlapayaḍiṃṭidivihattīe jadivi saṇṇiyāso ṇa sabhavai, to vi utto, uttarapayaḍīsu tassa sabhavadasaṇādo | jayadha0

cūrṇisū0-isī prakāra mithyātvaprakṛtikī nānā jīvoke sātha bhaṃgavicaya-prarūpaṇāke samāna śepa samyagmithyātva ādi moha-prakṛtiyokī bhī bhaṃgavicaya-prarūpaṇā karanā cāhie ||19||

[3 sthitivibhakti avihattiyā ca vihattio ca | 104. siyā abattiyā ca vihattiyā ca | 105 evamettha tiṇṇi bhaṃgā| 106. ajahaṇiyāe hidīe siyā sabje jīvā vihattiyā | 107. siyā vihattiyā ca avihattio ca | 108. siyā vihattiyā ca avihattiyā ca | 109. evaṃ tiṇi aṃgā| 110. evaṃ sesāṇaṃ paṇḍīṇaṃ kāyavyo | 111. jadhā ukkarasahidivaṃdhe ṇāṇājīvehi kālo tathā ukkarasahidisaṃtakammeṇa kāyavyo| 112. ṇavari sammatta-sammāmicchattāṇamukkassahidī jahaṇṇeṇa egasamao | 113. ukasseṇa āvaliyāe asaṃkhejadibhāgo| jaghanya sthitivibhaktike karanevāle bhī jīva pāye jāte hai | isa prakāra yahā~ jaghanya sthitivibhaktime ye upayukta tīna bhaṃga hote haiṃ ||100-105||

cūrṇimū0-jisa prakārase mohakarmaprakṛtiyoṃke utkṛṣṭasthitibandhame nānājīvokī apekṣā kālakā nirūpaṇa kiyā hai, usī prakārase yahaॉpara bhī sohaprakṛtiyoṃke utkṛṣṭa sthiti-sattvakā kālaprarūpaṇa karanā cāhie | arthāt samyaktva aura samyagmithyātva, ina do prakṛtiyoko choḍa़kara śepa chabbīsa prakṛtiyoke utkṛṣṭa sthitisattvakā jaghanyakāla eka samaya aura utkṛṣṭakāla palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa hai| kintu samyaktva aura samyagmithyātva, ina do prakṛtiyoke utkṛṣṭa sthitisattvakā jaghanyakāla eka samayamātra hai ||111-112||
viśepārtha-isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki mohakarmakī aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvālā aura utkṛṣṭa sthitivālā mithyādṛṣṭi jīva jaba vedakasamyaktvako prāpta hotā hai, tava usake prathama samayame hī mithyātvakarmakī utkṛṣṭa sthitiko samyaktva aura samyagmithyātva, ina donome saṃkramaṇa karatā hai, so saṃkramaṇa honeke prathama samayame hī ina dono prakṛtiyoṃkā utkṛṣṭa sthiti-sattva kamase kasa eka samayamātra pāyā jātā hai |
cūrṇisū0-samyaktva prakṛti aura samyagmithyātva, ina donoṃ prakṛniyoke utkṛṣṭa sthitisattvakā utkṛṣṭakāla āvalīke asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki mohakarmake utkṛṣṭa sthitimattvavāle mithyāpṭi jīva nirantara āvalīke agnaṃgyātaye bhāgamātra kāla taka hī vedakasamyaktvako prāpta hote hue dekhe jāne haiṃ ||113||

cūrṇisū0-samyagmithyātva aura anantānuvandhī-kapāyacatuṣka, ina prakṛtiyokī jaghanya sthitivibhaktikā jaghanya antarakāla eka samaya hai aura utkṛṣṭa antarakāla kucha adhika caubīsa dina-rātri hai | krodha, māna aura māyā ye tīna saṃjvalanakapāya tathā purupaveda, ina prakṛtiyokī jaghanya sthitivibhaktikā jaghanya antarakāla eka samaya aura utkṛṣṭa antarakāla kucha adhika varpa-pramāṇa hai | lobhasaṃjvalanakapāyakī jaghanya sthitivibhaktikā jaghanya antarakāla eka samaya

112 kasāya pāhuḍa sutta

cūrṇisū0-mithyātvakarmakī utkṛṣṭa sthitibandhavāle jīvake anantānubandhī ādi solaha kaṣāyokā sthitisattva kyā utkṛṣṭa hotā hai athavā kyā anutkṛṣṭa hotā hai ? utkṛṣṭa bhī hotā hai aura anutkṛṣṭa bhī hotā hai ||145-146||

solaha kapāya aura navanokapāyokī bhujākāra vibhaktikā utkṛṣṭakāla unnīsa samaya-pramāṇa hai || 257-258 ||
viśeṣārtha - ukta unnīsa samayokā spaṣṭīkaraṇa isa prakāra hai- kisī eka aise ekendriya yā vikalendriya jīvane jisakī āyu sattaraha samaya se adhika eka āvalī - pramāṇa śepa rahī hai, anantānuvandhī krodhako choḍakara śepa anantānubandhī māna, māyādi pandraha prakṛtiyokā kramaśaḥ addhākṣaya ho jānese pandraha samayoke dvārā unakī sthitiko uttarottara baḍha़ākara bandha karate hue saṃkramaṇake yogya kiyā | punaḥ bandhāvalīkālake vyatīta honepara aura sattaraha samayapramāṇa āyuke śeṣa rahanepara pūrvokta āvalīkālame prathama samaya se lekara pandraha samayome vṛddhi karake bāṃdhī huī ukta pandraha kapāyoṃ kī sthitiko vandha-paripāṭī ke anusāra anantānuvandhī krodhame saṃkramaṇa karanepara anantānubandhī krodha - sambandhī bhujākāravibhakti ke pandraha samaya prāpta hote hai | punaḥ solahave samayame addhākṣayase anantānubandhī krodha ke sātha sthiti ko baḍha़ākara vaॉdhanepara bhujākāravibhaktikā solahavā~ samaya prāpta hotā hai | puna: sattarahave samayamai saṃkleśakṣaya honese anantānubandhī krodhake sātha sarva kapāyokī sthitiko baḍha़ākara baॉdhanepara bhujākāravibhaktikā sattarahavā~ samaya prāpta hotā hai | punaḥ usake eka vigraha karake saṃjñī paṃcendriya jīvoma utpanna honeke prathama samayame asaṃjñī jīvoke yogya sahasra sāgaropamake sāta bhāgome se yathāyogya cāra bhāgapramāṇa vaॉdhanepara bhujākāravibhaktikā aṭṭhārahavā~ samaya prāpta huā | punaḥ śarīrako grahaṇa karake saṃjñī paṃcendriyoke yogya antaḥ koḍa़ākoḍa़ī sāgaropama sthitikā bandha karanepara bhujākāra - vibhaktikā unnīsavaॉ samaya prāpta hotā hai | isa prakāra bhujākārasthitivibhaktike sūtrokta unnīsa samaya siddha ho jāte hai | ūpara jisa prakāra se anantānuvandhī krodhakī bhujākāravibhaktike unnīsa samayokī prarūpaṇā kī hai, usī prakāra māna, māyādi śepa pandraha prakṛtiyome se hara eka kī isī paripāṭī se bhujākārasthitivibhaktike unnīsa samayokī prarūpaṇā jānanā cāhie| isī prakāra navo nokapāyokī bhī bhujākāravibhakti - viśepārtha-cūrṇisūtrame śepa karmoṃke jisa sannikarṣako jāna lenekī sūcanā kī gaī hai, vaha isa prakāra hai-jo jīva mithyātvakī bhujākāravibhaktivālā hai, vaha solaho kapāyoṃ aura navo nokapāyokī kadācit bhujākāravibhaktivālā hai, kadācit alpataravibhaktivālā hai aura kadācit avasthitavibhaktivālā hai| isī prakāra mithyātvakī avasthitavibhaktikā bhī sannikarpa jānanā cāhie| jo mithyātvakī alpataravibhaktivālā hai, usake samyaktvaprakṛtikā sthitisattva kadācit hotā hai aura kadācit nahīṃ bhī hotā hai | yadi hotā hai to kadācit alpataravibhaktivālā, kadācit bhujākāravibhaktivālā, kadācita avasthitavibhaktivālā

cūrṇisū0 - kintu usa eka sthitiviśeṣame jo utkṛṣṭa gata viśeṣa hai, vaha asaṃkhyāta samayapravaddhapramāṇa hai | arthāt guṇitakarmāśika jīvake utkṛṣṭa dravyamene usīke jaghanya dravyake nikāla dene para jo śepa dravya rahatā hai, vaha asaṃkhyāta samayapravaddhapramāṇa hai | isakā abhiprāya yaha huā ki isa eka nipeka sthiti me asaṃkhyāta samayapravaddhamātra pradeśasthāna nirantara utpanna hote hue pāye jāte hai | kintu yaha utkṛṣṭagata viśeṣa usa jaghanya satkarmarūpa pradeśasthānake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa hī hotā hai, arthāt jaghanyapradeśa satkarmasthānake asaṃkhyātave bhāgamātra yahaॉpara nirantara vṛddhiko prāpta hue pradeśa - satkarmasthāna pāye jāte hai, isa kāraṇa isa sthitiviśeṣame eka hī spardhaka hotā hai | do sthitiviśeṣo pradeśāma do spardhakapramāṇa hote hai | isa prakāra eka samaya kama āvalīmātra spardhaka pāye jāte hai | antima sthiti-saṃḍake carama samayame jaghanya spardhakako ādi karake mithyātvakā utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmasthāna prāpta hone taka eka spardhaka pāyā jātā hai || 25-30 ||

38. ahaṇhaṃ kasāyāṇaṃ jahaṇṇayaṃ padesasaṃtakammaṃ kassa ? 39. abhavasiddhiyapāoggajahaṇṇayaṃ kāūṇa tasesu āgado saṃjamāsaṃjamaṃ saṃjamaṃ sammattaṃ ca bahuso laghṛṇa cattāri vāre kasāe uvasāmiṇa eidiyaṃ gado | tattha palidovamassa asaṃkhejadibhāgasamyaktvako aneka vāra prāpta kara, tathā cāra vāra kapāyokā upaśamana karake do vāra chayāsaṭha sāgaropama kālataka samyaktvako paripālana kara mithyātvako prāpta huā| vahaॉpara dīrgha udvelanakālake dvārā samyagmithyātvakā udvelana kiyā, usakā jaba sarvadravya udvelana kara diyā gayā aura udayāvalī bhī gala gaī, tathā jaba eka sthitiviśeṣame do samayapramāṇa kālakī sthitivālā dravya śeṣa rahā, taba usa jīvake samyagmithyātvakā jaghanya pradeśa satkarma pāyā jātā hai | tadanantara pradeśottarake kramase arthāt jaghanya sthānake ūpara utkarpaṇa-apakarpaṇake dvārā eka pradeśake baḍha़nepara samyagmithyātvake pradeśasatkarmakā dvitīya sthāna hotā hai | punaḥ dvipradeśottarake kramase arthāt jaghanya dravyake ūpara utkarṣaṇa-apakarpaṇake vaśase do karmaparamāṇuoke baḍha़nepara pradeśasatkarmakā tīsarā sthāna hotā hai| isa prakāra eka eka pradeśa adhikake kramase nirantara baḍha़te hue sthāna utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmarūpa sthāna taka pāye jāte hai | jisa prakārase samyagmithyātvake jaghanyasthānase lekara utkṛṣṭa sthāna taka svāmitvakā nirūpaṇa kiyā hai, usī prakārase samyaktvaprakṛtike svāmitvakā nirūpaṇa karanā cāhie | ina dono hī prakṛtiyoke satkarmoṃkā eka spardhaka hotā hai, kyoki jaghanya satkarmase lekara pradeśottara, dvipradeśottarake kramase nirantara vṛddhiṃgata sthāna utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmasthāna taka pāye jāte hai || 31-37||
___ cūrṇisū0-āṭha madhyama kaṣāyokā jaghanya pradeśasatkarma kisake hotā hai ? jo ekendriya jīvomeṃ abhavyasiddhikoṃke yogya jaghanya dravyako karake trasajīvome āyā aura saṃyamāsaṃyama, saṃyama tathā samyaktvako aneka vāra prāptakara aura cāra vāra kapāyokā upagamana kara ekendriyome utpanna huā| vahaॉpara palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa kāla taka raha karake 1 uncalamāṇīṇa ucalaṇā egaṭṭiī dusāmaigā| diṭṭiduge vattīse udahisae pālie pacchā||40||

[5pradeśavibhakti ghettūṇa ve chāvahisāgarokmāṇi sammattaddhamaṇupāliūṇa micchattaṃ gaṃtūṇa ṇaqsayavedamagussesu uvavaṇṇo sabaciraṃ saṃjamamaṇupāliṇa khavedumāhatto| tado teṇa apacchimaḍḍidikhaṃḍayaṃ saṃchuhamāṇaṃ saṃchuddhaṃ udao ṇavariviseso tarasa carimasamayaṇakuṃsayavedassa jahaṇṇayaṃ padesasaṃtakamma | 48. tado padesuttaraṃ| 49. ṇiraṃtarāṇi hāṇāṇi jāva tappāoggo ukassao udao ti | 50. edamegaṃ phadayaṃ | 51. apacchimassa dvidikhaṃḍayassa carimasamayajahaṣṇapadamādi kādūṇa jāva ukassapadesasaṃtakammaṃ ṇiraṃtarāṇi hāṇāṇi | 52. evaṃ ṇabuṃsayavedassa do phaddayāṇi | 53. evamitthivedassa, ṇavari tipalidovamiesu ṇo uvavaṣṇo |
54. purisavedassa jahaṇṇayaṃ padesasaṃtakammaṃ kassa ? 55. carimasamayapurisavedodayakkhavageṇa gholamāṇajahaṇṇajogaṭṭhāṇe vaṭṭamāṇeṇa jaṃ kammaṃ baddha taṃ kammamāvaliyasamayaavedo saṃkāyedi | jatto pāe saṃkāmedi tatto pāe so samayapabaddho āvaliyāe akamma hodi | tado egasamayamosakidūṇa jahaṇṇayaṃ padesasaṃtakammaṭṭhāṇaṃ |
56. tassa kāraṇamimā parūvaṇā kāyavyā | samyaktvake kālako anupālakara aura punaḥ mithyātvako prāpta hokara napuṃsakavedī manuṣyome utpanna huā | vahā~ sarvādhika cirakālataka saṃyamakā paripālanakara karmoṃkā āpaṇa ārambha kiyā | taba usane saṃkramyamāṇa antima sthiti-khaṃḍako saṃkrānta kiyā, arthāt napuṃsakavedakī caramaphāliko sarvasaṃkramaṇake dvārā purupavedame saṃkramita kiyā| usa samaya udayame itanī viśeṣatā hai ki eka samayakī kālasthitivāle eka nipekake avaśiṣṭa rahanepara usa caramasamayavartī napuṃsakavedī jīvake napuṃsakavedakā jaghanya pradeśasatkarma hotā hai| tadanantara pradeśottarake kramase tatprāyogya utkṛṣṭa udaya prāpta hone taka nirantara sthāna pāye jāte hai, ye sthāna eka spardhaka-pramāṇa hai | antima sthitikhaṃḍake caramasamayavartī jaghanya padako ādi karake utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarma taka nirantara sthāna pāye jāte hai | isa prakāra napuṃsakavedake do spardhaka jānanā cāhie | isī prakārase strīvedake jaghanya pradeśasatkarmakā svāmitva bhī prarūpaṇa karanā cāhie | viśeṣatā kevala yaha hai ki use tīna palyopamakī āyuvāle jīvome utpanna nahīṃ karānā cāhie ||45-53||
cūrṇisū0-purupavedakā jaghanya pradeśasatkarma kisake hotā hai ? ghoṭamāna arthāta parivartamāna jaghanya yogasthāname vartamāna, carama samayavartī purupavedodayī kṣapakane jo karma vaॉdhā hai, usa karmako vaha apagatavedī hokara samayādhika āvalīkālase saṃkramaṇa prārambha karatā hai | jisa sthalase vaha saṃkramaṇa prārambha karatā hai, usa sthalase vaha samayamabaddha eka āvalīkālake dvārā akarmaspa hotā hai | usame eka samaya nīce jākara purupavedakā jaghanya pradeśasatkarmasthāna hotā hai || 54-55 ||

113. ṇāṇājīvehi bhaṃgavicao duviho jahaṣṇukkarasabhedehi | aṭṭhapada kāḍhūṇa savvakammāṇaṃ davvo |

"
viśeṣārtha - isa sūtra se sūcita sarva karmoṃkī jaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā kāla uccāraṇāvṛtti ke anusāra isa prakāra hai - midhyātva apratyākhyānācaraṇacatuṣka, pratyākhyānāvaraṇacatuṣka aura lobhako choḍa़kara śeṣa saṃjvalanatrika, tathā nava nokapāyokī jaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭakāla eka samaya hai | inhīṃ ukta karmoṃkī ajaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā kāla anādiananta aura anādi- sānta hai | samyagmithyātva aura samyaktvaprakṛtikī jaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭakāla eka samaya hai | inhīṃ dono karmākī ajaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanyakāla antarmuhūrta aura utkṛṣṭakāla sādhika eka sau battīsa sāgaropama hai | anantānubandhīcatuṣkakī jaghanyapradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭakāla eka samaya hai | anantānubandhīcatuṣkakī ajaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā kāla tīna prakāra kā hai - anādi - ananta, anādi- sānta aura sādi-sānta | iname se sādi - sāntakāla jaghanyase antarmuhūrta aura utkarṣase deśona ardhapudgala parivartanapramāṇa hai | saṃjvalana lobhakī jaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭakāla eka samaya hai | saṃjvalana lobhakī ajaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā kāla tīna prakāra kā hai - anādiananta, anādi-sānta aura sādi - sānta | iname se sādi-sānta jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭakāla antarmuhūrta -pramāṇa hai |
cūrṇisū 0 - ava pradeśavibhaktikā antara kahate hai - midhyātva ke utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakā jaghanya utkṛṣṭa antara asaṃkhyāta puḍhalaparivartanapramāṇa anantakāla hai | isī prakāra śepa karmoṃkā bhī jānanā cāhie | viśeṣatā kevala itanī hai ki samyagmithyātva, samyaktvaprakṛti, purupaveda aura cāro saṃjvalanakapāyokī utkṛṣṭapradeśavibhaktikā antara nahīṃ hotā hai | mohanīyakarmakī sabhī prakṛtiyokī pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya antara jāna karake kahanā cāhie arthāt kisī bhī karmakī jaghanya pradeśavibhaktikā antara nahī hotā hai ||108 - 112 ||
cūrṇisū00 - nānā jīvokī apekṣā bhaṃgavicaya do prakārakā hai- javanya ora utkṛṣṭa | unakā arthapada karake sarva karmoṃkā bhaṃgavicaya jānanā cāhie || 113 ||
viśeṣārtha - isa sūtra se sūcita sarva karmoṃkā nānājīvokī apekṣā bhaṃgavicaya karaneke lie yaha arthapada hai - jo jīva utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakī vibhaktivāle hote hai, ve jīva anutkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakī vibhaktivāle nahīṃ hote | tathā jo anutkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakī vibhaktivāle hote haiṃ, ve utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakī vibhaktivāle nahīṃ hote hai I isa artha anusāra mohakī

[5 pradeśavibhakti 114. sabakammāṇaṃ ṇāṇājīvehi kālo kāyavyo |
115. aṃtaraṃ | ṇāṇājīvehi savvakammāṇaṃ jahaṇṇeṇa egasamao| ukkasseṇa aṇaṃtakālamasaṃkhejā poggalapariyaṭṭā | sabhī prakṛtiyoke kadācit sarva jīva utkṛṣṭa pradeśa vibhaktivāle hote hai 1, kadācit aneka jīva vibhaktivāle aura koī eka jīva avibhaktivālā hotā hai 2, kadācit aneka jīva vibhaktivāle aura aneka jīva avibhaktivāle hote hai 3 | isa prakāra tīna bhaṃga hote hai| anutkṛṣṭa pradeśavibhaktike bhī isī prakāra tīna bhaṃga jānanā cāhie | isī prakāra sarva karmāke jaghanya ajaghanyapradeśavibhaktivāle jīvoke bhī tīna-tīna bhaṃga hote haiṃ| ādeśakī apekṣā kitane hī jīvoke āṭha bhaṃga taka hote haiṃ, so jayadhavalā ṭīkāse jānanā cāhie |
cūrṇisū0-nānā jīvokī apekṣā pradeśavibhaktike kālakī prarūpaṇā karanā cāhie||114||
viśeṣārtha-cūrṇikārake dvārā sūcita aura uccāraṇācāryake dvārā prarūpita nānājīvokī apekṣā sarva koṃkī pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā kāla isa prakāra hai-mithyātva, anantānuvandhī ādi vāraha kapāya aura puruṣavedako choḍa़kara śeṣa āṭha nokapāyokī utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā jaghanyakāla eka samaya hai aura utkṛṣṭakāla āvalīkā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga hai| inhī kā~kī anutkṛṣṭapradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā sarvakāla hai | samyagmithyātva, samyaktvaprakṛti, cāro saṃjvalana aura purupavedake utkṛṣṭapradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā jaghanyakāla eka samaya aura utkṛṣṭakāla saṃkhyāta samaya hai | inhī karmoṃkī anutkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā sarvakāla hai | nānājīvokī apekṣā mohakarmakī sabhī prakṛtiyoṃkī jaghanya pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā jaghanyakāla eka samaya hai aura utkṛṣṭakāla saṃkhyāta samaya hai| sarva karmoṃkī ajaghanya pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā sarvakāla hai | ādeśakī apekṣā utkṛṣṭa-anutkṛṣṭa aura jaghanya-ajaghanya pradeśasatkarmavibhaktikā kāla jayadhavalā ṭīkāse jānanā cāhie|
cūrṇisū0-ava nānā jīvokī apekṣā pradeśavibhaktikā antara kahate hai-nānā jīvokī apekṣā sarva karmoṃkī pradeśavibhaktikā jaghanya antara kāla eka samaya hai aura utkṛṣṭa antara asaṃkhyāta pudgalaparivartanapramita anantakāla hai || 115||
viśepārtha-mūlaprakṛtipradeśavibhaktikā jina vāīsa anuyogadvāroṃse isa adhikārake prāraṃbhame varṇana kiyā gayā hai, uname sannikarpako milākara teīsa anuyogadvārose uttaraprakṛtipradeśavibhaktikā varṇana karanā krama-prāpta thā | kintu grantha-vistārake bhayase cūrṇikārane unase kevala svāmitva, eka jīvakī apekṣā kāla aura antara kahakara nānājīvākī apekṣā bhaṃgavicaya, aura kālake jānanekī sūcanā karate hue nānājīvokī apekṣā pradeśavibhaktikā antara kahā hai, tathā āge alpabahutva kahege| madhyavartī śeya solaha anuyogadvārokā daśāmarśakarūpame kathana kiyā gayā hai, ataeva viśeṣa jijñāsujanoko śeṣa anuyogadvārose pradeśavibhaktikaṃ viśaṃpaparijñānārtha jayadhavalā ṭīkā dekhanā cāhie |

212 kasāya pāhuḍa sutta
[5 pradeśavibhakti 292. jahā ukkassayaṃ padesasaṃtakammaṃ tahā saṃtakammaṭṭhāṇāṇi |
__evaṃ padesavihattī samattā karmakā pradeśasatkarma prathama samayake samāna dvitīya samayameṃ bhī vanā rahe, vaha avasthita-pradeśavibhaktivālā hai | jisa jīvake vivakṣitakarmakā pahale pradeśasatkarma na hokara vartamāna samayame navīna pradeśasatkarma ho, vaha avaktavya-pradeśavibhaktivālā hai| bhujākāra-pradeśavibhaktimeṃ ina sabakā vistṛta vivecana samutkīrtanā, svāmitva ādi teraha anuyogadvārose kiyā gayā hai| padanikṣepa-adhikārame bhujākāra-pradeśasatkarmoṃkā hī utkṛṣṭa aura jaghanya padoke dvārā vṛddhi-hāni
aura avasthānakā viśepa varṇana kiyā gayā hai | isa adhikārame yaha batalāyā gayā hai ki koī jīva yadi vivakṣita karmakā prathama samayame amuka pradeśasatkarmavālā ho, to adhikase adhika usake pradeśasatkarmame kitanī vṛddhi ho sakatī hai aura kamase kama kitanī vṛddhi ho sakatī hai | isī prakāra yadi koī jīva vartamāna samayake pradeśasatkarmase anantaravartī dvitīya samayameṃ alpapradeśa satkarmavālā ho, to usake satkarmame adhikase adhika kitanī hāni ho sakatī hai aura kamase kama kitanī hāni ho sakatī hai | yadi samāna pradeśasatkarma vanā rahe, to kitane samaya taka banā rahegā, isa sabakā vicāra isa adhikārame samutkīrtanā, svāmitva aura alpavahutva ina tīna anuyogadvārose kiyā gayā hai | vṛddhi adhikārame padanikṣepakā hī paḍguṇī vṛddhi aura hānike dvārā pradeśasatkarma-sambandhī viśeṣa vicāra samutkīrtanādi teraha anuyogadvārose kiyā gayā hai, so viśeṣa jijñāsu janoko jayadhavalā ṭīkāke antargata uccāraṇāvṛttise jānanā cāhie |
cūrṇisū0-jisa prakāra svāmitva ādi anuyogadvārose utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmakā nirūpaṇa kiyā gayā hai, usī prakārase pradeśasatkarmasthānokī bhī prarūpaṇā karanā cāhie ||292||
viśepārtha-cūrṇikārane pradeśasatkarmake svāmitvakā varṇana karate hue pradeśasatkarmasthānokā bhī nirūpaṇa kiyā hai, ataeva ve pradeśavibhakti-adhikārakī samāpti karate hue usake antame pradeśasatkarmasthānoke varṇana karanekī bhī sūcanā uccāraṇācāryoṃ yā vyākhyānācāryoṃko kara rahe hai | pradeśasatkarmasthānokā varṇana prarūpaṇā, pramāṇa aura alpabahutvase kiyā gayā hai | karmoṃke jaghanya pradeśasatkarmasthānase lekara utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmasthāna takake sarva śānokā nirūpaṇa prarūpaṇā-anuyogadvārame kiyā gayā hai| pramāṇa-anuyogadvāramai vatalāyā gayā hai ki pratyeka pharmake pradeśasatkarmasthāna ananta hote haiṃ| pradeśasatkarmasthānokā alpavahutva pūrva prarūpita utkṛṣṭa pradeśasatkarmake alpabahutvake samāna hī jānanā cāhie | arthāt jisa karmake pradeśāya viśeṣa adhika hote haiṃ, usa karmake satkarmasthāna bhī viśepa adhika hote haiṃ| saṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśāgravāle karmake satkarmasthāna saṃkhyātaguṇita, asaṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśāgravāle karmake satkarmasthāna asaṃkhyātaguṇita aura anantaguṇita pradeśāgravāle karmake satkarmasthāna anantaguṇita hāta hai|
isa prakāra pradeśavibhakti samāpta huī |

1. eto jhīṇamajhīṇaṃ ti padassa vihāsā kāyavvā | 2. taṃ jahā 3. asthi okaṇādo jhīṇaṭṭhidiyaṃ, ukaḍaṇādo jhīṇaṭṭhidiyaṃ, saṃkamaṇādo jhīṇaḍidiyaṃ, udayādo jhaṭṭhidi |
kṣīṇākṣīṇādhikāra
cūrṇisū0 - aba isase āge cauthī mūlagāthā ke 'jhīṇamajhīṇaṃ' isa pakī vibhāpā karanā cāhie | vaha isa prakāra hai: - karmapradeśa apakarṣaṇase kṣīṇasthitika hai, utkarpaṇase kṣīṇasthitika hai, saṃkramaṇase kṣīṇasthitika haiṃ aura udayase kṣīṇasthitika hai ||1-3||
viśeṣārtha- pariṇāmaviśeṣase karma - pradeśa kī adhika sthitike hasva yā kama karaneko apakarpaṇa kahate hai | karmapradeśo kī laghu sthiti ke pariṇāmaviśepase baḍha़āneko utkarpaṇa kahate hai | eka prakṛti ke pradeśako anya prakṛtirūpa pariṇamāneko saṃkramaṇa kahate haiṃ | karmoṃ ke yathāsamaya phala- pradāna karaneko udaya kahate hai | jisa sthitime sthita karma-pradeśāma apakarṣaṇake ayogya hote hai, unhe apakarpaṇase kṣīṇasthitika kahate hai aura jisa sthitime sthita karma-pradeśā apakarṣaṇa ke yogya hote haiṃ, unhe apakarpaṇase akṣīṇasthitika kahate hai | isī prakāra jisa sthitike karma-paramāṇu utkarpaṇake ayogya hote hai, unheṃ utkarṣaṇase kṣīṇasthitika aura utkarpaṇa ke yogya karma - paramāṇuoko utkarpaṇase akṣīṇasthitika kahate hai | saṃkramaṇake ayogya karmaparamāṇuoko saṃkramaṇase kṣīṇasthitika aura saṃkramaṇake yogya karma - paramāṇuoko saṃkramaṇase akṣīṇasthitika kahate hai | jisa sthitime sthita karma - paramāṇu udayase nirjīrṇa ho rahe hai, unhe udayase kṣīṇasthitika kahate hai aura jo udayake yogya hai, arthāt āge nirjīrṇa hoge,
oṃ tāmrapatravālī pratimeṃ isa sūtra ke anantara 'samukkittaṇā parūvaṇā samittamappācahuaṃ cedi' yaha eka aura sūtra mudrita hai (dekho pṛ0 876) | para prakṛta sthalako dekhate hue yaha sūtra nahīṃ, apitu jayadhavalā ṭīkākā hī aśa hai yaha spaṣṭa jñāta hotā hai | tāḍapatrīya pratime bhī isake sūtratvakī puṣṭi nahīṃ huī hai|
1 okḍḍaṇā ṇāma pariṇāmaviseseṇa kammapadesāṇa ṭṭhidīe daharīkaraṇa | tado jhīṇā appā oggabhāveṇa vahidā hiṃdī jassa padesaggassa ta okḍugādo jhīgahidiya savvakammāṇamatthi | avā okṭuṇādo soṇā parihīṇā jāhidī ta gacchaditti okaṭṭaṇādo jhaṇahidigamidi samāmo vāyavvo | evamuvara savvattha | daddararrāṭṭhadiṭṭhidapadesaggāṇa ṭriṭadīe pariṇāmaviseseṇa vadrāvaṇa upaṭṭaṇā ṇāma | tatto jhīṇā didī jassata padesaggaṃ savyapayaḍīṇamatthi | sakamādo samayāviroheṇa eyaparyaṭapiṭesāṇa aṣṇadayaṭi pariṇamaṇakpaṇādo kṣīṇā ṭṭhidī jassa ta pi padesaggamatthi sandhemi kammāṇa | udayādo kammā pa dāṇapaṇādo śīṇā ṭiṭhadī jassa paḍhesaggamma ta ca savvakammāṇamatthi ni | jayadha

120. aradi - sogāṇa mokaḍaṇāditigajhīṇaḍidiyaṃ jahaṇṇayaṃ kassa 1 121. ei diyakammeṇa jahaṇṇaeṇa tasesu āgado, saṃjamāsaṃjamaṃ saṃjamaṃ ca bahuso ladghṛṇa tiṣṇi vāre kasā uvasāmeyūṇa evaṃ die gado | tattha palidovamassa asaṃkhejadibhāgamacchiyūṇa jāva uvasāmayasamayapavaddhā galaṃti tado maṇussesu āgado | tattha puvyakoḍī deṇaṃ saṃjama
pāliyūṇa kasā uvasāmeṇa uvasaṃtakasāo kālagado devo tettīsasāgarocamio jādo | tādhe ceya hasa -raīo okaḍidāo udadyādiṇikkhittāo aradi-sogā okaḍḍittā udayāvaliyavāhire ṇikkhittā, se kāle dusamayadevassa eyā ṭṭhidī araha - sogāṇa
samādhāna- isī napuṃsaka veda kī prarūpaṇāme pūrva prarūpita jīvane jisa samaya apaścima manuṣya bhavako grahaṇa kiyā aura deśona pūrvakoṭīkāla taka saṃyamakā paripālanakara jīvana ke antarmuhūrtaṃ śepa raha jānepara mithyātvako prāpta huā aura maraṇakara vimānavāsī deviyo meṃ utpanna huā | utpanna honeke antarmuhūrta paścāt hī, arthāt paryāpta hokara utkṛṣṭa saṃkleśako prāpta huā | usa saṃkleśa se jaba sarva karmoṃ ke antaḥkoḍa़ākoḍa़īpramāṇa sthitibandhase bhī dūra takakī sthitiyoṃko baḍha़āyā aura unake karmapradeśokā bhī utkarpaṇa kiyā, taba utkṛṣṭa antarmuhūrta kāla taka strīvedī pandraha koḍākoḍī sāgaropamapramāṇa utkṛṣṭa sthitiko vadha karake . saṃkleśase pratibhagna arthāt pratinivṛtta huā | saṃkleśase pratinivṛtta hone ke eka āvalīkāla bītane para usa devī strīvedakā udayakī apekṣā jaghanya kṣīṇasthitika pradeśāgra hotā hai || 119 ||
śaṃkā- arati aura śokaprakṛtikā apakarṣaṇādi tīnakī apekṣā jaghanya kṣīṇa - sthitika pradeśa kisake hotā hai ? || 120||
samādhāna - jo jīva jaghanya ekendriyakarmase arthāt abhavyasiddhoke yogya jaghanya satkarmake sātha ekendriyose ākara trasa jīvome utpanna huā | vahaॉpara saṃyamāsaṃyama aura saṃyamako bahuta vāra prāptakara tathā tīna vāra kapāyokā upaśamanakara punaḥ ekendriyo meṃ utpanna huā | vahā~para palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇakāla taka rahā, jabataka ki upaśāmaka samayaprabaddha galate haiṃ | usake paścāt manuṣyo me āyā | vahaॉpara deśona pūrvakoṭīkāla taka saṃyamakā paripālanakara aura kapāyokā upaśamana karake upaśāntakapāyavītarāgacchadmastha hokara aura maraṇako karake tetīsa sāgaropamakī sthitikā dhāraka ahamindradeva huā | usa hī samaya hāsya aura rati prakṛtiyokā apakarṣaṇakara udadyāvalīme nikṣipta kiyā aura arati śokakā tāmrapatravālī pratimeṃ 'tatya' pada nahīṃ hai | ( dekho pṛ0 915 ) |

samādhāna-jo jīva jaghanya ekendriyasatkarmake sātha some āyā aura vahaॉpara saṃyamāsaṃyama tathā saṃyamako bahuta vāra prāpta huā| cāra vāra kapāyokā upaśamana kiyā | tadanantara ekendriyome calā gayā| vahaॉpara palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgakāla taka rahā, jabataka ki upaśāmaka samayaprabaddha pūrṇarūpase gala jāte haiṃ| tadanantara vaha manuṣyome āyā | vahaॉpara deśona pūrvakoṭī taka saṃyamakā paripālanakara apratipatita samyaktvake sātha hī vaimānika devome utpanna huā| utpanna honeke antarmuhūrta paścāt, arthāt paryāptaka honepara utkṛṣṭa saṃkleśako prāpta huā aura antarmuhūrta taka arati-śokakī utkṛṣṭa sthitiko bā~dhakara saṃkleśase pratinivṛtta huā | usa āvalika-pratibhannake arthāt jise saṃklegase pratinivṛtta hue eka āvalīkāla vyatīta ho gayā hai aura jo bhaya tathā jugupsākā vaṃdana kara rahā hai, aise usa jīvake arati aura śokakā udayakī apekṣā jaghanya kṣīṇasthitika pradeśāgra hotā hai ||123||

ṭhidiyaṃ ti ahiyāro
1. ṭhidiyaṃ ti jaṃ padaṃ tassa vihāsā | 2. tattha tiṇṇi aṇiyogaddārāṇi | taṃ jahā - samukkittaṇā sāmittamappābahuaṃ ca | 3. samukkittaṇāe asthi ukastayaḍidipattayaṃ ṇiseyadvidipattayaṃ adhāṇiseyaṭṭhidipattayaṃ udayaṭṭhidipattayaṃ ca | 4. ukkassayaḍidipattayaṃ ṇāma kiṃ ? 5. jaṃ kammaṃ baṃdhasamayādo kampaṭṭhidīe udae dīsaha tamukassaya ḍidi -
sthitika adhikāra
cūrṇisū0 (0 - aba cauthī mūlagāthāke 'dvidiyaṃ vā' isa antima padakī vibhāpā kī jātī hai | isa sthitika-adhikārame tīna anuyogadvāra haiṃ | ve isa prakāra hai - samutkīrtanā, svāmitva aura alpabahutva | samutkīrtanākī apekṣā cāra prakārakā pradeśāgra hotā hai -- utkṛṣṭa sthitiprāptaka, nipekasthitiprāptaka, yathānipekasthitiprāptaka aura udayasthitiprāptaka || 1-3||
viśeṣārtha - aneka prakārakī sthitiyoko prāpta honevāle pradeśāgro arthāt karma - paramāṇuoko sthitika yā sthiti prāptaka kahate haiṃ | ye sthiti prāpta pradeśāgra utkṛṣṭasthiti, nipekasthiti, yathānipekasthiti aura udayasthitibhedase cāra prakāra ke hote hai | jisa vivakṣita karmakī jitanī utkṛṣṭa sthiti hai, utanī sthiti -pramāṇa vaॅdhanevālā jo karma-pradeśāya ba~dhane ke samaya se lekara apanī utkṛṣṭa karmasthitimātra kāla taka ātmā ke sātha rahakara apanī karma-sthitike antima samaya udayako prāpta ho, use utkṛṣṭa sthitiprāpta pradeśāgra kahate haiṃ, kyoki vaha apanī utkṛṣṭa sthitiko prāpta hokara udaya meṃ vartamāna hai | jo karma - pradeśāya baṃdhakālame jisa sthiti me nipikta kiyā gayā, vaha apakarṣaṇa yā utkarṣaṇako prāpta hokara bhī usa hī sthitime hokara udayakāla me dṛṣṭigocara ho, use nipekasthitiprāpta pradeśāya kahate hai | jo karma - pradeśāya vandhakāla meṃ jisa sthiti me nipikta kiyā gayā, vaha apakarṣaṇa yā utkarṣaṇako nahīṃ prāpta hokara jyo-kā-tyo avasthita rahate hue usa hī sthitike dvārā udayako prāpta ho, use yathānipekasthitiprāpta pradeśā kahate hai | jo karma- pradeśāya bandhakālake paścāt jaba kabhī bhī jisa kisī bhī sthiti hokara udayako prāpta ho, unheṃ udayasthitiprāpta pradeśāya kahate hai |
aba cūrṇikāra śaṃkā-samādhānapūrvaka ina cāroṃ bhedokā kramaśaḥ svampa kahate haiṃśaṃkā- utkṛṣṭasthitiprāptaka nāma kisakā hai ? || 4 ||

viśepārtha-isa sūtrakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa isa prakāra hai-jo mithyātvakarmakā pradeśāgra karmasthitike prathama samayame bandhako prāpta hokara aura sattara koḍākoḍa़ī sāgaropama-pramita karmasthitike asaṃkhyāta bahubhāgakāla taka avasthita rahakara palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa utkṛṣṭa nirlepanakālake avaśiṣṭa raha jānepara prathama samayame śuddha hokara arthāt karmarūpa paryāyako choḍa़kara ātmāse nirjīrṇa hotā hai, punaḥ usake uparima anantara samayamai śuddha hokara nirjīrṇa hotā hai, isa prakāra uttara-uttaravartī samayome karmaparyāyako choḍakara usake nirlepa hote hue karmasthitike pūrṇa honepara eka paramāṇukā bhī avasthāna sambhava hai, do paramāṇuokā avasthāna bhī sambhava hai, tīna paramāṇuokā bhī avasthāna sambhava hai, isa prakāra eka eka paramāṇukī vṛddhi karate hue adhikase adhika utane karma-paramāṇuokā pāyā jānā sambhava hai, jitane ki — samayaprabaddhakī agrasthitime utkṛṣṭa pradeśāgra nipikta kiye the| yahaॉpara samayapravaddhase abhiprāya utkṛṣṭa yogī saṃjñī paṃcendriya paryāptaka jīvake dvārā bā~dhe hue samayaprabaddhase hai, anyathā agrasthitime utkṛṣṭa nipekakā pāyā jānā sambhava nahīṃ hai| mithyātvake isa utkṛṣṭa agrasthitiprāpta pradeśātrakā svāmī koī bhī jīva ho sakatā hai, aisā sāmānyase kahā gayā hai, to bhī kṣapitakāṃśikako choḍa़ karake hī anya kisī bhī jīvake usakā svāmitva jānanā cāhie, kyoki kṣapitakāśika jīvake utkṛṣṭa sthitiprāpta pradeśāgrakā pāyā jānā sambhava nahīṃ hai| __ śaṃkā-mithyātvakā utkṛṣṭa yathānipekasthitiprāptaka kisake hotā hai ? ||18||
samādhāna-isakā saṃdarśana (spaṣṭīkaraṇa) isa prakāra hai-udayane, arthāta mithyātvake yathānipekasthitiko prāpta svāmitvake samayase jaghanya āvādhāke kālapramāṇa nīce ākarake jo baddha samayabaddha hai, usakā pradeśāgra vivikṣita sthiti meṃ yathānipekasthitiko prāma nahīṃ hotā hai| eka samaya adhika āvādhāke vyatīta honepara ima antima namayaprabaddhakā yathānipeka hotā hai | isa eka samaya adhika jaghanya āvādhākālase āge calakara ba~dhe hue samaya prabadvane lekara nīce jitane asaṃrayāta palyopamake prathamavargamūlīkā pramāṇa hai, utane mamayoṃne ba~dhe hue samayaprabaddhokā yathānika vivakṣita sthitima niyamase hotā hai ||19-20||

73. jeṇa micchattassa racido adhāṇiseo tassa caiva jīvassa sammattassa adhāṇiseo kāyaaat | ṇavari tisse ukkassiyāe sammattavāe carimasamae tassa carimasamayasammāiṭṭhissa jahaṇṇayamadhāṇiseyaṭṭhi dipattayaṃ | 74. ṇiseyādo ca udayādo ca jahaṇṇayaṃ dvidipattayaṃ kassa 175. uvasamasammattapacchāyadassa paḍhamasamayavedayamammāiṭṭhi - sta tappā oggaukassasaṃki liṭussa tassa jahaṇṇayaṃ | 76. sammattassa jahaṇṇao ahāṇiseo jahā parūvio tīe ceva parūvaṇāe sammāmicchattaṃ gao, tado ukkassiyāe sammāmicchattaddhāe carimasamae jahaṇṇayaṃ sammāmicchattassa adhāṇiseya ṭṭhidipattayaṃ | 77, sammāmicchattassa jahaṇṇayaṃ ṇiseyādo udayādo ca dvidipattayaṃ kassa 178 sammattapacchāyadassa paḍhamasamayasammāmicchāiṭṭhissa tappā oragukkassa saṃkiliṭṭhassa |

83. vārasakasāyāṇaṃ ṇiseyaḍi dipattayamudayaṭṭhidipattayaṃ ca jahaṇaṇayaṃ kassa 1 śaṃkā- anantānubandhī cāro kapāyokā niṣekase aura yathāniṣekase jaghanya sthiti-prāpta pradeśa kisake hotā hai 1 || 79 ||
samādhāna - jo jīva jaghanya ekendriyasthitisatkarma ke sātha paṃcendriyome utpanna huā aura antarmuhūrtake dvārā samyaktvako prāpta huā | punaḥ anantānubandhī kaṣāyokā visaṃyojana karake girā aura hrasva ( sarvaṃ laghu ) kālase anantānubandhī kapāyokā puna: saṃyojana kiyā | punaḥ ati laghu antarmuhūrta se samyaktvako prāpta huā | mithyātvako prāpta hone ke eka āvalī - kālake paścāt usa midhyādṛṣṭi jīvake anantānuvandhī kaṣāyokā nipekase aura yathānipekase jaghanya sthitiko prāpta pradeśāya hotā hai || 80||

[ 5 saṃkrama-arthādhikāra 45. sammāmicchattassa saṃkāmao ko hoi ? 46. micchāiṭṭhī uccellamāṇao | 47. sammāṭṭhī vā ṇirāsāṇo | 48. mottūṇa paḍhamasamayasammāmicchattasaṃtakammiyaṃ | 49. daṃsaṇamohaṇīyaṃ caritamohaṇīe ṇa saṃkamai | 50. caritamohaṇīyaṃ pi daṃsaṇamohaṇīe ṇa saṃkamaha | 51. aṇaṃtāṇubaṃdhī jattiyāo cajjhati carittamohaṇīyapaḍīo tāsu savvāsu saṃkamai | 52. evaṃ savvāo caritamohaṇīyapayaḍīo | 53. tāo paṇuvīsaṃ pi caritta mohaṇīyapapaḍīo aṇṇadarasta saṃkarmati |
54. eyajīveṇa kālo | 55. micchattassa saṃkāmao kevaciraṃ kālādo hodi 1 56. jahaṇeṇa aṃtomuhuttaṃ | 57. ukasseṇa chābaḍisāgarovamāṇi sādireyāṇi | 58. sammattassa saṃkāmao kevaciraṃ kālādo hodi 159. jahaṇeṇa aṃtomuhuttaṃ | 60. ukkasseṇa palidovamassa asaṃkhejjadibhāgo | 61. sammāmicchattassa saṃkāmao kevaciraṃ kālādo hodi 162. jahaṇṇeṇa aṃtomuhuttaṃ | 63. ukasseṇa ve chāvaṭṭisāgarocamāṇi gaī ho, vaha mithyādṛṣṭi jīva samyaktvaprakṛtikā saṃkramaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai ||43-44|| śaṃkā-samyagmithyātvakā saṃkrāmaka kauna jīva hai ? || 45 ||
samādhāna - samyagmithyātvakī udvelanā karanevālā midhyādṛṣṭi jīva samyagmithyātva - kā saṃkrāmaka hotā hai | āsādanāse rahita upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva bhī samyagmithyātvakā saṃkrāmaka hotā hai | tathā prathama samaya me samyagmithyātvakī sattāvāle jīvako choḍa़kara sarva vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi bhī samyagmithyātva ke saṃkrāmaka hote hai ||46-48||
cūrṇi sū0 - darśanamohanīya karma cāritramohanīyakarmase saṃkramaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai | cāritramohanīyakarma bhī darśanamohanīya karmame saṃkramaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai | cāritramohanīya karma kī jitanī prakṛtiyā~ ba~dhatī haiṃ, una sabame anantānuvandhīkā saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | isī prakāra sarva cāritra - mohanīya - prakṛtiyā~ bhī anantānuvandhīme saṃkramaṇa karatī hai | cāritramohanīyakī ye paccīso hī prakṛtiyā~ kisī bhī eka prakṛtime saṃkramaṇa karatī hai ||46-53 ||
cūrṇisū0 0 - aba eka jīvakī apekṣā saṃkramaṇakā kāla kahate hai ||54 || śaṃkā- mithyātva ke saṃkramaṇakā kitanā kāla hai ? || 55 ||
·
.
samādhāna - mithyātva ke saṃkramaṇakā jaghanyakāla antarmuhūrta hai aura utkṛṣṭa kāla kucha adhika chayāsaṭha sāgaropama hai ||56-57||
śaṃkā-samyaktvaprakṛti ke saṃkramaṇakā kitanā kāla hai ? || 58||
samādhāna-samyaktvaprakṛtike saṃkramaṇakā jaghanyakāla antarmuhūrta hai aura utkṛṣṭakāla palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa hai ||59-60||
śaṃkā-samyagmithyātva ke saṃkramaṇakā kitanā kāla hai ? || 61 ||
samādhāna- samyagmithyātva ke saṃkramaṇakā jaghanya kāla antarmuhūrta aura utkṛṣṭa kāla kucha adhika do vāra chayāsaṭha sāgarotrama hai || 62-63||

ina ūpara kahe gaye sthānoṃse avaśiṣṭa rahe hue saṃkraya aura pratigrahasthāna upaśamaka aura kṣapaka saṃyatake hī hote haiṃ | bīsa-prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkraya chaha aura pāṃca-prakṛtika do pratigrahasthānoṃmeṃ jānanā cāhie ||34||
_ viśeṣārtha-uparyukta gāthāoke dvārā sattāīsa, chabbīsa, pañcīsa, teīsa, vāīsa aura ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthānoke pratigrahasthānokā nirūpaṇa kiga jā cukā hai| aba unake atirikta jo sattaraha saṃkramasthāna avaśiṣṭa rahe hai, unake pratigrahasthānākī sūcanā isa gāthāke dvārā kī gaī hai| isame sarvaprathama batalāyā gayā hai ki vīsa ādika avaśiṣṭa saṃkramasthāna
aura unake chaha, pā~ca ādi pratigrahasthāna saṃyamase yukta guṇasthānome hī hote hai, anyatra nahīṃ| saṃyama-yukta guṇasthānomeṃ bhī ve upaśāmaka aura kṣapakake hī sambhava hai, sabake nahīṃ, isa vātake vatalāneke lie gāthāme 'upaśāmaka' aura 'kṣpaka' ye do pada diye hai| uname bhī vīsaprakṛtika saṃkramasthānakā saṃkramaṇa chaha aura paॉca-prakṛtika pratigrahasthāname hī hotā hai, sabame nahīṃ, yaha vāta gāthāke uttarārdha dvārā sūcita kī gaī hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle jīvake upaśamaśreṇīpara caḍha़ karake napuṃsakaveda aura strīvedakā upaśamana karake puruṣavedako pratigraha-prakṛtirūpase vyucchinna kara denepara samyagmithyātva, samyaktvaprakṛti
aura saṃjvalanacatuṣka, ina chaha prakṛtirūpa pratigrahasthāname vīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthānakā saṃkrama hotā hai| aura ikkīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle jīvake upaśamaśreṇīpara caḍha़ karake ānupūrvīsakramake karanepara vīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthānakā saṃjvalanacatuṣka aura purupavedarūpa paॉca-prakṛtika pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai|

pratigrahasthānoṃ meṃ saṃkramasthāna-nirūpaṇa cattāri tiga cadukke tiṇi tige ekage ca boddhavvā |
do dusu egāe vā egā egāe boddhavvā ||38|| sthānoṃmeṃ hotā hai| sāta-prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama cāra aura tīna-prakṛtika pratigrahasthānoṃ meṃ jānanā cāhie | chaha-prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama niyamase do-prakṛtika pratigrahasthāna meṃ hotā hai | pā~ca-prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama tīna, do aura eka-prakṛtika pratigrahasthānameṃ hotā hai ||37||

meṃ hotā hai| tīna prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama tīna aura eka prakṛtika pratigrahasthāna meṃ jānanā cāhie | do- prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama do aura eka prakṛtika pratigrahasthāna meṃ hotā hai | eka prakṛtika sthānakā saṃkrama eka prakṛtika pratigrahasthāna meṃ jānanā cāhie ||38||

viśeṣārtha - isa gāthāme cāra, tīna, do aura eka prakṛtirūpa saṃkramasthānāṃ ke pratigrahasthānokā nirdeśa kiyā gayā hai | unakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa isa prakāra hai - kṣapakake chaha nokapāyokā kṣaya ho jānepara purupaveda aura tīna saṃjvalanokā cāra saṃjvalanarūpa pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | caubīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle upaśāmakake tīna māyākapāyokā upagama ho jānepara do lobha, samyagmidhyātva aura samyaktvaprakṛtirūpa tīna prakṛtika pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | kṣapakake puruṣavedakā kṣaya ho jānepara saṃjvalanakrodha, māna aura māyākā saṃjvalana māna, māyā aura lobharūpa tīna - prakṛtika pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | ikkīsa prakṛtiyo kī sattāvāle upaśāmaka ke do māyākaṣāyokā upaśama ho jānepara eka māyā aura do lobha, ina tīna prakṛtiyokā eka saṃjvalanalobharūpa pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | kṣapakake krodhakā kṣaya ho jānepara saṃjvalanamāna aura māyā, ina do prakṛtiyokā saṃjvalana māyā aura lobharūpa doprakṛtika pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | athavā cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle upaśāmaka ke do lobhakaṣāyokā upaśama ho jānepara mithyātva aura samyagmithyātva ina do prakṛtiyokā samyagmithyātva aura samyaktvaprakṛtirūpa do-prakṛtika pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai| ikkīsa prakṛtiyo kī sattāvāle upaśāsakake tīno māyākapāyokā upaśama ho jānepara do lobhakapāyokā eka saṃjvalana lobharūpa pratigrahasthāna me saṃkramaṇa hotā hai | kṣapakake saṃjcalanamānakā kṣaya ho jānepara eka māyāsaṃjvalanakā eka lobhasaṃjvalanaprakṛtirūpa pratigrahasthāname saṃkramaṇa hotā hai |

gā0 39 ) satvasthānoṃ meṃ saṃkramasthāna-nirūpaṇa
271 aṇudhuvvamaṇaṇupuvvaṃ jhīṇamajhīṇaṃ ca daṃsaṇe mohe | uvasāmage ca khavage ca saṃkame maragaṇovāyā ||39||

honepara āṭhakā saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 9 | saṃjvalanamānake upaśama honepara sātakā saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 10 | dono madhyama māyākaṣāyoke upaśama hone para paॉcakā saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 11 | saṃjvalanamāyāke upaśama honepara cārakā saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 12 | dono madhyama lobhoke upaśama honepara mithyātva aura samyagmithyātva ina do hī prakṛtiyokā saṃkramaṇa hotā hai 13 | isa prakāra cauvīsa-prakṛtika sattvasthānake sātha ūpara vatalāye gaye teraha saṃkamasthāna pāye jāte hai| isī jīvake śreṇīse utarate hue jo saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte hai, ve punarukta honese uparyukta saṃkramasthānīke hī antargata ho jāte hai| tathā cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle samyagmithyāṣṭike ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna aura darśanamohanīyakā kṣapaṇa karanevāle jīvake mithyātvakī carama phālīke patanake anantara pāyā jānevālā bāīsaprakṛtika saṃkramasthāna bhī punarukta honese pṛthak nahīṃ kahā gayā hai| aba teīsake sattvasthānake sātha saṃbhava saṃkramasthānokī gaveṣaṇā karate hai-cauvīsakī sattāvāle jīvake darśanamohakī kṣapaṇāke lie abhyudyata hokara mithyātvakā kṣapaṇa kara denepara teīsake sattvasthānake sātha vāīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai | punaḥ usīke dvārā samyagmithyātvako kṣapaṇa karate hue samayona āvalīmātra gopucchāoke avaśiṣṭa rahanepara usī teīsake sattvasthānake sātha ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 2 | isa prakāra teīsa-prakṛtika sattvasthānake sātha vāīsa aura ikkīsa-prakṛtika do saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte haiṃ | isī upayukta jīvake dvārā samyagmithyātvake niḥśeparūpase kṣaya kara denepara vāīsake sattvasthāna ke sātha ikkīsa-prakṛtika eka hī saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai| aba ikkīsake sattvasthānake sātha saṃbhava saṃkramasthānokī gavepaṇā karate hai-kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭike ikkīsake sattvasthānake sātha ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 1 | punaḥ usake upaśamaśreṇīpara caḍha़kara ānupūrvī-saṃkramaṇake karanepara ikkīsake sattvake sātha vīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 2 | isī prakārase isake anantara saṃbhava daśa saṃkramasthānokā anumārgaṇa kara lenā cāhie| isa prakāra ikkīsake sattvake sātha upaśamaśreṇīkī apekṣā 21,20,19,18,12,11,9,8,6,5,3 aura 2 prakṛtika vāraha saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte hai| tathā kṣapakaśreṇīkī apekṣā āṭha madhyama kapāyokā kṣapaṇa karate hue samayona āvalīmātra gopucchāoke avaśiṣṭa rahanepara ikkīsake sattvake sātha teraha-prakṛtika sattvasthāna bhī pāyā jātā hai| ise pūrvokta vārahame milā denepara kula 13 saṃkramasthāna ikkīsake sattvasthānake sātha pāye jāte haiṃ | punaḥ usī kṣapakake dvārā āṭho madhyama kapāyoke kṣapaṇa kara denepara teraha prakṛṭhiyoke sattvasthānake sātha teraha-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 1 | punaḥ usī jīvake dvārā antakaraṇa karaneke paścāt ānupūrvī-saṃkramaṇa karanepara terahaprakṛtika sattvasthānake sātha vāraha-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna bhī pāyā jātā hai 2 | isa prakāra terahake sattvasthānake sātha teraha aura vāraha-prakṛtika do saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte haiṃ | isī jīvake dvārā napuṃsakavedakā kṣayakara denepara vārahake sattvasthānake sātha gyāraha-prakṛtika

284
kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [5 saṃkrama-arthādhikāra jātā hai 2 | isa prakāra ikkīsake vandhasthāname pañcīsa aura ikkīsa-prakṛtika do saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte haiṃ | aba sattaraha-prakṛtika vandhasthānameṃ saṃkramasthānokī mārgaṇā karate hai-samyagmidhyādṛṣṭi jīvake sattaraha-prakṛtika bandhasthānake sātha anantānubandhīkī visaṃyojanā aura
avisaṃyojanākī apekṣā ikkīsa aura pañcīsa-prakṛtika do saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte hai 2 | aṭṭhāīsa prakṛtiyoṃkī sattāvāle asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi jīvake sattaraha-prakṛtika bandhasthānake sātha sattāīsaprakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 3 | upaśamasamyaktvake grahaṇa karaneke prathama samayameṃ vartamāna asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭike sattaraha-prakṛtika bandhasthānake sātha chabbīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 4 | usīke anantānuvandhīkī visaṃyojanā karane para teīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 5 | strīvedakā upaśamana kara deneke anantara mithyātvakā kṣaya karanepara usīke vāīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 6 | aura samyagmithyātvakā kṣaya kara denepara usīke ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai| isa prakāra sarva milākara sattaraha-prakṛtika vandhasthāname uparyukta chaha saṃkramasthāna hote haiṃ | ava teraha-prakṛtika vandhasthāname saṃkramasthānokī gavepaṇā karate haiṃ-saṃyatāsaṃyatake teraha-prakṛtika bandhasthānake sātha sattāīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 1 | prathamopaśamasamyaktvake sātha saṃyamāsaṃyamake grahaṇa karaneke prathama samayame vartamāna usī saṃyatāsaṃyatake terahake vandhake sātha chabbīsakā saṃkramasthāna pāyā ātā hai 2 | anantānuvandhīkī visaṃyojanā karanevāle saṃyatāsaṃyatake teīsakā saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 3 | usīke dvārā mithyātvakā kṣaya kiye jānepara vāīsakā saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 4 | samyagmithyātvake kṣaya karane para usīke ikkīsakā saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 5 | isa prakāra teraha-prakṛtika vandhasthāname sattāīsa, chabbīsa, teīsa, vāīsa aura ikkīsa-prakṛtika pāṃca saṃkramasthāna hote haiṃ| ava nau-prakṛtika vandhasthāname saṃkramasthānokī anumārgaṇā karate hai-pramatta-apramattasaṃyatake nauprakṛtika vandhasthānake sātha sattāīsakā saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 1 | upaśamasamyaktvake sātha saṃyamako eka sātha prāpta honevāle apramattasaṃyatake prathama samayame nau-prakṛtika bandhasthānake sātha chabbīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 2 | anantānuvandhīkī visaṃyojanā-pariṇata pramatta-apramattasaṃyatake nau-prakṛtika vandhasthānake sātha teīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 3 | usī bandhasthānake sātha mithyātvake kṣayakī apekṣā vāīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 4 | tathā samyagmithyātvake kṣayakī apekṣā ikkīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 5 | isa prakāra nau-prakṛtika bandhasthānome sattāīsa, chabbīsa, teīsa, vāīsa aura ikkīsaprakṛtika pāṃca saṃkramasthāna hote haiṃ| aba pāṃca-prakṛtika vandhasthāname saṃkramasthānokā anvepaṇa karate haiṃ-cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle anivṛttikaraṇa-guṇasthānavartī upaśāmakake pāṃcaprakṛtika vandhasthānake sātha teīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai | vahīpara ānupūrvīsaṃkramake vāse vāīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 2 | napuṃsakavedake upaśamana karanepara ikkīsapakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 3 | strīvedakā upaśamana karanepara vīsa-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna

prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 4 | kṣapakake dvārā saṃjvalanamānake vandha-viccheda kara denepara usake navakabandha-saṃkramaṇakī apekṣā do-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai| aura usake niḥśeṣa kṣaya kara denepara eka-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai | isa prakāra do-prakṛtika vandhasthāname āṭha, sāta, chaha, pā~ca, do aura eka-prakṛtika chaha saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte hai| aba eka-prakṛtika bandhasthānameṃ pāye jānevāle saṃkramasthānoṃkā -nirūpaṇa karate hai-cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle upaśāmakake dvārā dono madhyama mānakapāyoke upaśama karanepara saṃjvalanamāyāke navakabandhake sātha paॉca-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 1 | punaḥ saṃjvalanamāyāke upaśama kara denepara cāra-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai 2 | ikkīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle upaśāmakake dvārā donoṃ madhyama māyākaṣāyoke upaśama karanepara saṃjvalanamāyāke navakavandhake sātha tīna-prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 3 | saṃjvalanamāyāke upaśama kara denepara do prakṛtika saṃkramasthāna hotā hai 4 | aura eka saṃjvalanalobhakā vandha karanevāle kṣapakake saṃjvalanamāyāke saṃkramaṇarūpa ekaprakṛtika saṃkramasthāna pāyā jātā hai | isa prakāra eka-prakṛtika bandhasthāname pā~ca, cāra, tīna, do aura eka-prakṛtika paॉca saṃkramasthāna pāye jāte hai| isa prakāra banvasthānomeṃ saṃkramasthānokī prarūpaṇā samāpta huī|

203. ekkavīsāe saṃkāmao kevaciraṃ kālādo hoi 1 204, jahaṇeṇeya -
isa prakāra hai - cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvālā koī upaśāmaka prathama samayameṃ tīna prakārake māna kaṣāyake upaśamase pariṇata huā aura dūsare hī samaya meṃ maraṇa karake devomeṃ utpanna ho gayā | isa prakāra prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā eka samayamātra jaghanyakāla siddha ho jātā hai | isī jīvake dono madhyama māyākapāyokā upaśamana karate hue jaba taka unakā anupaśama rahatā hai taba takakā antarmuhūrtamāna kāla prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā utkṛṣṭa kāla jānanā cāhie | pāṃca- prakṛtika saṃkramasthānake kālakā vivaraṇa isa prakāra hai - isī upayukta sāta prakṛtiyo ke upaśāmaka ke dvārā dono madhyama māyākapāyokā upaśamana karake eka samaya pāṃca prakṛtiyokā saṃkrāmaka vanakara aura dūsare samayame mara karake deva ho jāne para eka samayamātra prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā jaghanya kāla prāpta ho jātā hai | ikkīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvāle upaśāmaka ke dvārā tīna prakārake mānakī upaśāmanāse pariṇata hokara jaba taka dono madhyama māyā kapāyokā anupaśama rahatā hai, taba takakā antarmuhūrtamātra kāla prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā utkṛṣṭa kāla jānanā cāhie | cāra prakṛtika saṃkramasthānake jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa kālakā vivaraṇa isa prakāra hai- cauvīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvālā koī eka upaśāmaka saṃjvalana - māyākā upaśamana karake cāra prakṛtiyokā saṃkrāmaka huā aura dūsare hī samaya me marakara deva ho gayā, isa prakāra prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā eka samayamātra jaghanya kāla prāpta ho jātā hai | isī upaśāmakake saṃjvalanamāyāke upaśamakālase lekara jabataka donoṃ madhyama lobhokā anupāma rahatā hai, tabatakakā antarmuhūrtamātra kāla prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā utkṛṣṭa kāla jānanā cāhie | tīna-prakṛtika saṃkramasthānake jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa kālakā vivaraṇa isa prakāra hai - ikkīsa prakṛtiyo kī sattāvālā koī eka upaśāmaka dono madhyama māyākapāyokī upaśāmanāse pariṇata hokara tīna prakṛtiyokā saṃkrāmaka huā aura dūsare samayame marakara deva ho gayā | isa prakāra eka samayamātra prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā jaghanya kāla siddha ho jātā hai | cāritramohakā kṣapaṇa karanevāle jīvake saṃjcalanakrodhake kṣapaṇakā jitanā kāla hai, vaha saba prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā utkṛṣṭa kāla jānanā cāhie | do- prakṛtika saṃkramasthānake jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa kālakā vivaraṇa isa prakāra hai - caubīsa prakṛtiyokī sattāvālā koī eka upaśāmaka ānupūrvī saṃkramaṇa ādikī paripāṭīse dono prakārake madhyama lobhakā upaśamana karake midhyātva aura samyagmithyātvakā eka samaya saṃkrāmaka hokara dūsare samayame marakara deva ho gayā | isa prakāra prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā jaghanya kāla prāpta ho jātā hai | isī jīvake donoṃ madhyama krodhoke upaśamana - kālase lagā karake upaśāntakapāyaguṇasthānase utarate hue sūkṣmasāmparāyaguṇasthānake antima samaya takakā jitanā kāla hai, vaha saba prakṛta saṃkramasthānakā utkṛṣṭa kāla jānanā cāhie |

śaṃkā-vivakṣita sthitiyokā apakarṣaṇa karake adhastana sthitiyome use kaise nikṣipta kiyā jātā hai ? tathā udayāvalīke caramasamaya - apraviṣṭa jo sthiti hai, arthāt vaha sthiti jo udayāvalīme praviṣṭa nahī hai aura udadyāvalīke bāhira uparitana prathama samaya me sthita hai, kaise apakarṣita kī jātī hai ? arthāt usa sthitikā apavartanārūpa saṃkramaṇa kisa prakāra se hotā hai ? || 3-4 ||
samādhāna- udayāvalī ke bāhira sthita prathamasthitiko apakarṣita karake udayāvalī ke prathama samayavartī udayase lekara āvalīke tribhāga taka nikṣipta karatā hai, āvalīke uparima do tribhāgo me nikṣipta nahī karatā | ataeva udyāvalīkā prathama tribhāga usa udadyāvalībāhya sthita prathama sthitike nikṣepakā viṣaya hai aura āvalīke śeṣa do tribhāga atisthāpanārūpa hai | arthāt udayāvalī ke uparitana prathama samayavālī sthiti ke pradeśo kā apakarpaṇa kara unhe udayāvalīke antima do tribhāgoko choḍa़kara prathama tribhāgame sthāpita kiyā jātā hai | prathama tribhāgame bhī udayarūpa prathama samayame bahuta pradeśāya diyā jātā hai, usase paravartī dvitīya samayamai viśeṣa hīna pradeśāya diyā jātā hai, usase paravartī tṛtīya samaya meṃ aura bhī viśeṣa

samādhāna-utkṛṣṭa āvādhā aura eka samaya adhika āvalīse hīna utkṛṣṭa karmasthitikā jitanā pramāṇa hotā hai, utanā utkṛṣṭa nikṣepakā pramāṇa hai ||27||
viśeṣārtha-pūrvame baṃdhe hue karmapradeśokī navīna bandhake sambandhase sthitike baḍha़āneko udvartanā yā utkarpaṇā kahate hai| yaha udvartanā bhī nirvyāghāta aura vyāghātakī apekṣā do prakārakī hotī hai | vyāghātase honevālī udvartanā āge kahī jāyagī | yahaॉpara nirvyāghātakī apekṣā udvartanākā varṇana kiyā jā rahā hai, usakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa yaha hai ki vivakṣita jisa kisī jīvake jisa samaya jo sthitiyā~ baṃdha rahī haiṃ, unake ūpara pūrvame baṃdhī huī sthitiyokī udvartanā hotī hai | usa udvartyamāna sthitikī āvalī-pramāṇa jaghanya atisthāpanā hotī hai
aura āvalīke asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa jaghanya nikṣepa hotā hai | utkṛṣṭa atisthāpanākā pramāṇa utkṛṣṭa āvādhākāla hai| utkṛṣṭa nikṣepakā pramāṇa utkṛṣṭa āvādhā aura eka samaya adhika āvalīse kama utkṛṣṭa karmasthiti hai, usa āvādhākālake antargata jitanī sthitiyā~ haiṃ, unake karmapradeśokī udvartanā nahīṃ kī jā sakatī, ataeva ve udvartanāke ayogya hai | āvādhākālase pare jo sthitiyā~ hai, ve udvartanāke yogya hotī hai | ābādhākālake vītanepara jaba ghe sthitiyāṃ udayako prāpta hotī haiṃ, to eka āvalī takakī sthitiyokī jise ki udayāvalī kahate haiṃ, udvartanā nahī kī jā sakatī| jaghanya nikṣepase lekara utkṛṣṭa nikṣepa takake jitane madhyavartī bheda hote hai, tatpramāṇa hī nikṣepasthāna hote haiṃ |
śaṃkā-vyāghātakī apekṣā udvartanā kaise hotī hai ? ||28||
samādhāna-yadi pūrva-baddha satkarmase navīna vandha eka samaya adhika hai, to usa sthitike ūpara satkarmakī agrasthitikī udvartanā nahīṃ hogī| yadi pūrvabaddha satkarmase navīna vandha do samaya adhika hai, to usake ūpara bhī satkarmakī agrasthitikī udvartanā nahīṃ hogī | jitanī

399 palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa sthitikhaṃḍako eka antarmuhūrta ke dvārā utkīrṇa karatā hai | arthāt udvelana karatā hai | ukerane yā ukelanekā nāma utkīrṇa yā udvelana hai | punaḥ dvitīya yaha krama palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgakāla taka jārī rahatā hai| itane kālame vaha ukta dono prakṛtiyokī udvelanā kara ḍālatā hai, arthāt unhe niḥśeṣa kara detā hai| ye eka-eka antarmuhūrtame honevāle uttarottara sthitikhaṃḍa yadyapi sabhī palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa hai, tathāpi uttarottara viśeṣa hīna hai| yaha sthitisaṃkramaṇakī apekṣā varṇana hai| pradeśasaṃkramaṇakī apekṣā to pūrva-pūrva sthitikhaṃḍase uttarottara sthitikhaṃḍoke karmapradeśa viśeṣa-viśepa adhika haiṃ| pradeśoke utkīraṇakī vidhi yaha hai ki prathama samayameṃ alpapradeśokā utkīraṇa karatā hai| dvitīya samayameṃ usase asaṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśokā, tṛtīya samayame usase bhī asaṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśokā utkīraṇa karatā hai| isa prakāra yaha krama pratyeka antarmuhūrtake antima samaya taka rahatā hai| __prayoga-viśeṣake dvārā kitanī karma-prakṛtiyoṃko udayāvalīke bhītara praveśa karatā hai ? tathā kisa jīvake kitanī karma-prakṛtiyoṃko udīraṇāke binā hī sthitikṣayase udayāvalīke bhītara praveśa karatā hai ? kṣetra, bhava, kāla aura pugaladravyakā āśraya lekara jo sthiti-vipāka hotā hai, use udīraṇā kahate haiṃ aura udaya-kṣayako udaya kahate haiṃ ||59||

466
kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [6 vedaka-arthādhikāra ko kadamāe dvidīe pavesago ko va ke ya aṇubhāge | sāṃtara ṇiraṃtaraṃ vā kadi vā samayā du boddhavvā ||60|| bahugadaraṃ bahugadaraṃ se kāle ko ṇu thovadaggaṃ vā | aṇusamayamudīreṃto kadi vā samayaṃ (ye) udīredi ||61|| jo jaṃ saṃkāmedi ya jaṃbaṃdhadi jaṃca jo udīredi | taṃ keṇa hoi ahiyaṃ dvidi-aṇubhāge padesagge ||62||
kauna jīva kisa sthitimeṃ praveśa karānevālā hai aura kauna jīva kisa anubhāga meṃ praveśa karātā hai| tathā inakā sāntara aura nirantara kāla kitane samayapramāṇa jānanā cāhie ||6||
viśeṣārtha-yadyapi gāthāke prathama caraṇase sthiti-udīraṇākā aura dvitīya caraṇase anubhāga-udīraṇākā ullekha kiyā gayā hai, tathāpi sthiti-udīraṇā prakṛti-udīraṇākī aura anubhāga-udīraṇā pradeśa-udīraṇākī avinābhāvinī hai, ataḥ gāthāke pūrvārdhase cāro udīraṇāokā kathana kiyā gayā samajhanā cāhie | gāthāke uttarārdha-dvārā ukta cāro udīraṇāokī kālaprarūpaṇā aura antaraprarūpaṇā sūcita kī gaī hai| tathā gāthāke uttarārdhame paṭhita dvitīya 'vā' śabda anuktakā samuccaya karanevālā hai ataḥ usase gāthāsūtrakārake dvārā nahīṃ kahe gaye samutkīrtanā ādi śeṣa anuyogadvārokā grahaṇa karanā cāhie |
vivakṣita samayase tadanantaravartī samayameṃ kauna jīva bahutakī arthāt adhikase adhikatara karmākī udīraṇā karatā hai aura kauna jīva stokase stokatara athot alpa karmoṃkī udīraṇā karatā hai ? tathā pratisamaya udīraṇā karatā huā yaha jīva kitane samaya taka nirantara udīraṇā karatā rahatā hai ||61||
viśepārtha-gāthāke prathama caraṇase prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśa udīraṇāsambandhī bhujākāra padakā nirdeśa kiyā gayā hai aura dvitīya caraṇase unhīke alpatara padakī sūcanā kī gaī hai | gāthāke pūrvārdhame paṭhita 'vā' śabdale avasthita aura avaktavya padokā grahaṇa karanā cāhie| isa prakāra gāthāke pūrvārdha-dvārā prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśa-udīraṇā-viṣayaka bhujākāra anuyogadvārakī prarūpaṇā kī gaī hai | gāthāke uttarārdha-dvārā bhujākāra-vipayaka kālānuyogadvārakī sūcanā kī gaī hai| aura isī deśāmarśaka vacanase śepa samasta anuyogadvārokā bhī saṃgraha karanā cāhie| tathā isīke dvārā hī padanikṣepa aura vṛddhi bhī kahī gaī samajhanā cāhie , kyoki bhujākārake viśepako padanikṣepa aura padanikṣepake viśepako vṛddhi kahate hai|
jo jīva sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśāgra meṃ jise saṃkramaṇa karatā hai, jise cā~dhatā hai aura jisakī udīraṇā karatā hai, vaha dravya kisase adhika hotā hai (ora kisase kama hotā hai )? ||62||

___ cūrṇisū0-pravāhyamāna upadeśakī apekṣā krodhādi kapāyoke kālakī viśeṣatā antarmuhūrta hai | ||19||
viśepārtha-ūpara jo oghakī apekṣā kaṣāyokā kāla-sambandhī alpavahutva batalāyā gayā hai, vaha jisa jisa sthānapara viśeṣa adhika kahā gayā hai, vahā~ vahā~ para viśepa adhikase antarmuhūrtakālakī adhikatā samajhanā cāhie| vaha antarmuhūrta yadyapi aneka bhedarūpa hai, koī saṃkhyāta āvalīpramāṇa, koī āvalīke saṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa aura koī āvalīke asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇa hotā hai| kintu yahā~ para pravāhyamāna upadeśake anusāra āvalīke asaṃkhyātave bhāgamātra hī viśeṣa adhika kāla samajhanā cāhie | jo upadeśa sarva ācāryoṃse sammata hai, cirakālase avicchinna sampradāya-dvārā pravāharūpase ā rahā hai, aura guru-śiṣya-paramparāke dvārā prarūpita kiyā jātā hai, vaha pravāhyamāna upadeśa kahalātā hai | isase bhinna jo sarva ācārya-sammata na ho aura avicchinna guru-śiṣya-paramparāse nahīṃ ā rahā ho, aise upadeśako apravāhyamāna upadeśa kahate haiṃ| athavā āryamaṃkṣu ācāryake upadeśako apravāhyamāna aura nāgahasti kṣamāśramaṇake upadeśako pravāhyamāna upadeśa samajhanā cāhie|
cūrṇisa0-usī pravāhyamāna upadeśakī apekṣā ava cāro gatiyokā samuccaya āśraya karake kapāyoke kāla-sambandhī alpavahutvako kahate hai-caturgatike samāsase jaghanya aura ukṛṣṭa padakī apekṣā narakagatimeṃ lobhakapāyakā jaghanyakāla sabase kama hai | (kyoki dveṣa-bahula nārakiyome jāti-viśepase hī preyarūpa lobhapariṇāmakā cirakāla taka rahanā asa

cūrṇisū0- 'jo jo jīva jisa kaṣāyameṃ vartamānakālameṃ upayukta haiṃ, kyā ve jīva atītakālameṃ usī kaṣāyase upayukta the' isa chaṭhī gāthākī kāla-yoni arthāt kāla-mūlaka prarūpaṇā karanā cāhie | vaha kāla-mūlaka prarūpaṇā isa prakāra hai-jo jīva isa vartamāna-samayameṃ mānakapāyase upayukta haiṃ, unakā atītakālameṃ mānakāla, nomānakāla aura miśrakāla, isa prakārase tīna prakārakā kāla vyatīta huā hai ||238-240||
viśepārtha-jisa kālaviśeṣame vivakṣita vartamānakālika mānakaṣāyopayukta samasta jīvarāśi ekamātra mānakaṣāyopayogase hī pariṇata pāī jātī hai, usa kālako 'mānakāla kahate haiṃ | isī vivakṣita jīvarāśimese jisa kāla viśeṣameṃ eka bhī jīva mānakapāyameṃ upayukta na hokara krodha, māyā aura lobhakaṣāyomeṃ hī yathāvibhāga pariṇata ho, usa kālako 'nomānakāla' kahate hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki vivakṣita mānakaṣāyake atirikta śeṣa kaṣāya 'nomāna' isa nāmase vyavahṛta kiye jāte hai | punaḥ isī vivakṣita jīvarāśimese jisa kālameṃ thoḍa़ī jīvarāśi mānakaṣāyase upayukta ho aura thoḍa़ī jīvarāśi krodha, māyā athavā lobhakaṣāyameṃ yathāsaṃbhava upayukta hokara pariṇata ho, usa kālako 'miśrakāla' kahate haiṃ| mānakaṣāyase upayukta jīvoṃkā ukta tīna prakārakā kāla vyatīta huā hai|

hai | usī mānakapāyase upayukta jīvarāśikā atītakāla meṃ māyākapāya- sambandhī māyākāla, nomāyākāla aura miśrakāla, tathā lobhakapāya -sambandhī lobhakāla, nolobhakāla aura miśrakāla, isa prakāra se tīna tīna prakārakā aura bhī kāla vyatīta huā hai | isa prakāra se upayukta cāro kaṣāya-sambandhī tīno kāloke bheda milākara mānakapāyase upayukta jīvokā yaha kāla bāraha prakārakā ho jātā hai |

upaśāmaka-viśeṣa svarūpa-nirūpaṇa (44) uvasāmago ca savvo ṇivvāpādo tahā ṇirāsāṇo|
uvasaṃte bhajiyavvo ṇīrāsāṇo ya khīṇammi ||17|| dvīpa aura samudroṃmeṃ, sarva guhya arthāt vyantara devoṃmeṃ, samasta jyotiṣka devoṃmeṃ, saudharma kalpase lekara nava graiveyaka takake sarva vimānavāsī devoṃmeṃ, ābhiyogya arthāt vāhanādi kutsita karmameṃ niyukta vāhana devoṃmeṃ, unase bhinna kilviṣika ādi anuttama, tathā pāriṣada ādi uttama devoṃmeṃ darśanamohanīya karmakā upaśama hotā hai ||16||
viśeṣārtha-yahā~ yaha śaṃkā kī jā sakatī hai ki aḍhāī dvīpa-samudravartī saṃkhyāta yā asaṃkhyāta varṣāyuṣka garbhaja manuṣya-tiryaṃcoke to prathamopaśama samyagdarśanake utpanna karanekī yogyatā hai | kintu aḍha़āī dvīpase paravartī jo asaṃkhyāta dvīpa-samudra hai aura jiname ki trasa jīvokā abhāva batalāyā gayā hai, vahaॉpara bhī darśanamohake upaśama honekā vidhāna isa gāthāmeṃ kaise kiyā gayā hai ? isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki jo aḍha़āī dvīpavartī tiryaṃca yahaॉpara - prathamopaśamasamyaktvake utpanna karaneke lie prayatna-śīla the, unheṃ yadi pūrva bhavakā vairī koī
deva uṭhākara una asaṃkhyāta dvīpa yā samudromeṃ jahā~ kahīṃ bhī pheṃka āve, to una jīvoko vahā~ para prathamopaśamasamyaktva utpanna ho sakatā hai| atīta kālakī apekṣā aisā koī dvīpa aura samudra nahīṃ bacā hai ki jahaॉpara pūrva-vairī devoke dvārā apahṛta tiryaṃcoke darśanamohakā upaśama na huā ho | ataḥ sarva dvīpa-samudromeṃ apaharaṇakī apekṣā darśanamohake upaśamakā vidhāna kiyā gayā hai|
darśanamohake upaśāmaka sarva jīva nirvyāghāta tathā nirāsāna hote haiṃ| darśanamohake upaśānta honepara sāsādanabhāva bhajitavya hai| kintu kṣīṇa honepara nirāsāna hī rahatā hai ||17|| . viśeṣārtha-darśanamohake upaśamana karanevāle jīvake jisa samaya 'upaśāmaka' saṃjñā prāpta ho jātī hai, usa samayake paścāt jaba taka darśanamohakā upaśama nahīṃ ho jātā hai, taba taka vaha nirvyāghāta rahatā hai | arthāt sarva prakārake upadrava, upasarga yā ghorase ghora vighna-bādhāe~ ānepara bhī usake darśanamohakā upaśama ho karake hī rahatā hai| apūrvakaraṇa aura anivṛttikaraṇa pariṇāmoke prāraṃbha ho jāneke paścāt saṃsārakī koī bhī śakti usake samyaktvotpattimeṃ vyāghāta nahīṃ kara sakatī hai | na usakā usa avasthāmeṃ maraṇa hī hotā hai | darśanamohake upaśāsakako nirāsāna kahanekā artha yaha hai ki darśanamohanīyakā upaśamana karate hue vaha sāsādana guṇasthānako nahīṃ prāpta hotā hai| kintu darśanamohake upaśānta ho jānepara bhajitavya hai arthāt yadi upaśamasamyaktvake kālame kucha samaya śepa rahā hai, to vaha sāsādanaguṇasthānako prāpta hotā hai, anyathā nahī | isīko spaṣṭa karaneke lie kahā gayā hai ki upaśamasamyaktvakā kāla kṣīṇa arthāt samāpta ho jānepara nirāsāna arthāt sāsādanaguṇa sthānako nahī prāpta hotā

[ 10 samyaktva arthādhikāra
hai | jayadhavalākārane ' athavā ' kahakara gāthāke isa caturtha caraṇakā yaha bhī artha kiyā hai ki darśanamohanīyake kṣīṇa ho jānepara arthāt kṣāyikasamyaktvake utpanna ho jānepara jīva sāsādanaguṇasthānako nahī prāpta hotā hai |
sākāropayoga meṃ vartamāna jīva hī darśanamohanīyakarma ke upaśamanakā prasthāpaka hotā hai | kintu niṣṭhāpaka aura madhya avasthāvartī jīva bhajitavya hai | tīnoṃ yogoṃ meṃ se kisī eka yoga meṃ vartamāna aura tejoleśyā ke jaghanya aṃśako prāpta jīva darśanamohakā upaśamana karatā hai ||98||
1
viśeṣārtha - darśanamohakā upaśama prārambha karanevālā jīva adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇa ke prathama samayase lekara antarmuhūrta kāla taka prasthāpaka kahalātā hai | mati, śruta yā vibhaṃgame se kisī eka jñānopayoga se upayukta jīva hī darśanamohake upaśamako prārambha kara sakatā hai, darśanopayogase upayukta jīva nahī kara sakatā| kyoṃki, avīcārātmaka yā nirvikalpaka darśanopayoga se darśana mohake upaśamakā honā saṃbhava nahīṃ hai | gāthāke isa prathama caraṇa se yaha artha dhvanita kiyā gayā ki jāgṛta-avasthā pariṇata jīva hī samyaktvotpatti ke yogya hai, nirvikalpa, sutta, yāmata ādi nahīṃ | darśanamohake upaśamanākaraṇako sampanna karanevālā jīva niṣṭhāpaka kahalātā hai | darśanamohakā upaśāmaka jaba sarva prathamasthitiko kramase galākara antara- praveśa ke abhimukha hotā hai, usa samaya use niṣṭāpaka kahate hai | darśanamohopaśamana ke prasthāpana aura niṣṭhā - pana kālake madhyavartī jīvako yahā~ madhyama padase vivakṣita kiyā gayā hai | yaha madhyavartī aura niṣṭhāpaka jīva bhajitavya hai, arthāt sākāropayogī bhī ho sakatā hai aura anākāropayogī bhī | darśanamohanīyake upaśamakā prasthāpaka cāro manoyogome se kisī eka manoyoga meṃ, cāro vacanayogo meṃ se kisī eka vacanayogameṃ tathā audārikakāyayoga aura vaikriyikakāyayogamese kisī eka kāyayogameṃ vartamāna honā cāhie | isī prakāra use jaghanya tejoleśyā se pariṇata honā āvaśyaka hai | tejoleśyākā yaha niyama manuṣya tiryaṃcoṃkī apekṣāse kahā gayā jānanā cāhie | manuṣya - tiryaṃcome koī bhī jīva kitanī hī manda viśuddhise pariṇata kyo na ho, use kamase kama tejoleśyāke jaghanya aṃśase yukta hue binā samyaktvakī utpatti asaṃbhava hai | ukta niyama deva aura nārakiyoṃmeṃ saṃbhava isalie nahīṃ hai ki devoke sadā kāla śubha leśyā aura nārakiyoṃke aśubha leśyā hī pāī jātī hai |
upaśāmakake mithyātvavedanīyakarmakā udaya jānanā cāhie | kintu upaśānta avasthāke vināśa honepara tadanantara usakā udayaṃ bhajitavya hai || 99 ||

viśeṣārtha-darśanamohanīyakā upaśamana karanevālā jīva jaba taka antara-praveśa nahīṃ karatā hai, taba taka usake niyamase mithyātvakarmakā udaya vanā rahatā hai| kintu darśanamohake upaśānta ho jānepara upaśamasamyaktvake kālame mithyātvakā udaya nahīṃ hotā hai| jaba upaśamasamyaktvakā kāla naṣṭa ho jātā hai, taba usake paścāt mithyātvakā udaya bhajanīya hai, arthāt mithyātvako prāpta honevāle jīvake usakā udaya hotā hai, kintu sāsādana, miśra yā vedakasamyaktvako prāpta honevāle jīvake mithyātvakā udaya nahīṃ hotā hai| jayadhavalākārane athavā kaha kara aura ‘ṇatthi' padakā adhyāhāra karake gāthāke tṛtīya caraṇakā yaha artha bhī kiyā hai ki upaśamasamyaktvake kālake bhītara aura sāsādanakālake bhītara mithyātvakā udaya nahīṃ hotā hai|
darśanamohake mithyātva, samyagmithyātva aura samyaktvaprakṛti, ye tīnoṃ kāśa, darśanamohakī upaśānta avasthāmeṃ sarvasthitiviśeṣoṃke sātha upaśānta rahate haiṃ, arthāt usa samaya tīnoṃ prakṛtiyoṃ meṃ se kisī ekakī bhī kisī sthitikā udaya nahīṃ rahatā hai | tathā eka hī anubhāgameṃ una tīnoṃ karmāśoṃke sabhī sthitiviśeṣa niyamase avasthita rahate haiṃ ||10||
viśeṣārtha-yahā~ yadyapi eka hī anubhāgame sarva sthitiviśeṣa rahate haiṃ, arthāt antarase bāhira anantaravartī jaghanya sthitiviśeṣameṃ jo anubhāga hotā hai, vahīṃ anubhāga utkṛṣṭa sthitiparyanta usase ūparake samasta sthitiviśeṣomeṃ hotā hai, usase bhinna prakārakā nahīṃ hotā, aisā sāmānyase kahā hai, tathāpi mithyātvake dvisthānīya sarvaghātī anubhāgase samyagmithyātvakā anubhāga anantaguṇita hīna hotā hai aura samyagmithyātvake anubhāgase samyaktvaprakṛtikā deśaghātī dvisthānīya anubhāga anantaguṇita hīna hotā hai, itanā viśeṣa artha jānanā cāhie|
___ upaśāmakake mithyātvapratyayaka arthāt mithyātvake nimittase mithyātvakā aura jñānāvaraṇādi karmoṃkā vandha jānanā cāhie | kintu darśanamohanīyakī upaśānta avasthāmeṃ mithyātva-pratyayaka vandha nahīṃ hotā hai| upaśānta avasthāke samāpta honepara usake paścāt mithyātvanimittaka vandha bhajanīya hai ||10||
viśepārtha-darśanamohake upaśama karanevāle jīvake antarase pūrvavartī prathama sthitike antima samaya taka mithyātva-nimittaka bandha hotā hai, kyoṃki yahā~ taka vaha mithyādṛṣṭi hai

phasāya pāhuḍe sutta | [10 samyaktva-arthādhikāra (49) sammāmicchāiṭṭhī daṃsaṇamohassa'baṃdhago hoi |
__vedayasammāiṭṭhī khīṇo vi abaṃdhago hoi ||102|| (50) aṃtomuttamaddha savvovasameṇa hoi upasaṃto|
tatto paramudayo khalu tiṇṇekadarassa kammarasa ||103|| aura usake mithyātvakā, tathā mithyātvake nimittase baṃdhanevāle anya karmoṃkā vandha hotā rahatā hai | yadyapi yahā~para asaṃyama, kaṣāya ādi anya pratyayose bhī karmoṃkā vandha hotā hai, tathāpi unakī yahā~ vivakṣā nahīṃ kī gaī hai, kyoki jahaॉpara mithyātvapratyaya vidyamāna hai vahā~ para asaṃyamādi śeṣa pratyayoṃkā astitva svataḥ siddha hai | antarameṃ praveśa karaneke prathama samayase lekara upaśamasamyaktvake kālake bhītara mithyātvanimittaka vandha nahīṃ hotā hai| kintu jaba upaśamasamyaktvakā kāla samāpta ho jātā hai, taba mithyātvanimittaka bandha mithyātvako prāpta honevāle jīvake to hotā hai, kintu samyagmithyātva yā samyaktvaprakṛtike udayako prāpta honevāle jīvake nahīṃ hotā hai | jayadhavalākārane 'āsāṇe' padakā artha 'ṇatthi' padakā adhyāhāra karake yaha kiyā hai ki sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭike bhī mithyātva-nimittaka vandha nahīṃ hotā hai |
samyagmithyādṛṣṭi jīva darśanayohakā avandhaka hotā hai| isī prakāra vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi, kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi, tathā 'api' śabdase sūcita upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi aura sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva bhī darśanamohakā avandhaka hotā hai ||102||
viśeṣārtha-jayadhavalākārane 'athavā' kahakara isa gāthāsūtrake eka aura bhī arthaviśeṣako vyakta kiyā hai| vaha yaha ki jisa prakāra mithyādṛṣṭi jīva mithyātvakarmake udayase midhyātvakarmakā vandha karatā hai, usa prakāra kyā samyagmithyādṛṣṭi jīva samyagmithyātvake udaya honese samyagmithyātvakarmakā aura vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi jīva samyaktvaprakṛtikā udaya honese samyaktvaprakṛtikā vandha karatā hai ? isa praśnakā uttara yaha hai ki samyagmithyādṛṣṭi na to samyagmithyātvakā vadha karatā hai aura na vedakasamyagdṛṣṭi samyaktvaprakṛtikā vandha karatā hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki ina donoṃ prakṛtiyoṃko karmasiddhāntame bandhaprakṛtiyoṃme nahīṃ gināyā gayā hai| kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭi to darśanamohakā abaṃdhaka hotā hī hai, kyoki vaha to tīno hī prakṛtiyoṃkā kṣaya kara cukā hai|
upaśamasamyagdṛṣṭi jīvake darśanamohanīyakarma antarmuhartakāla taka sarvopaśamase upaśānta rahatā hai| isake paścāt niyamase usake mithyātva, samyagmithyātva aura samyaktvaprakṛti ina tīna karmomeṃse kisī eka karmakā udaya ho jātā hai ||103||
viśepārtha-gāthāsūtrameṃ paṭhitta 'antarmuhūrtakāla' isa padase antara-kālakī dīrghatāke saṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgakā grahaṇa karanā cāhie| sarvopaśamakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki upaśamasamyaktvake kālameṃ darśanamohanīyakī tīno prakṛtiyoṃkā prakṛti, sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśasambandhī udaya sarvathā nahīṃ pāyā jātā hai| upaśamasamyaktvakā kāla samāpta honepara tīnoṃ

aura samyaktvaprakṛvikī udvelanā kara palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgamātra kālataka, athavā isase bhī ūpara deśona ardhapudgalaparivartana kāla taka saṃsārame paribhramaṇa karate haiṃ, unheṃ - viprakṛṣṭa sādimithyādṛṣṭi kahate hai| jo mithyātvame pahu~cane ke paścāt palyopamake asaṃ
khyātave bhāgake bhītara hī bhītara samyaktva grahaṇa karaneke abhimukha hote hai, unheṃ aviprakṛṣṭa sādimithyādṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ| inameṃ se viprakṛṣṭa sādimithyādṛṣṭi to niyamase sarvopaśamake dvārā hī prathamopaśamasamyaktvakā lāsa karatā hai| kintu aviprakṛṣṭa sādimithyādṛṣṭi sarvopaśamase bhī aura deśopaśamase bhī prathamopaśamasamyaktvako prāpta karatā hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki jo samyaktvase girakara punaḥ punaḥ alpakālake dvārā vedaka-prāyogyakālake bhītara hī samyaktvako grahaṇa karaneke abhimukha hotā hai, vaha to deśopaśamake dvārā samyaktvakā lābha karatā hai, anyathā sarvopaśamase samyaktvakā lābha karatā hai|

(54) sammāiṭṭhī sahadi pavayaṇaṃ ṇiyamasā du uvaiṭuṃ | sahadi sambhāvaṃ ajāṇamāṇo guruṇiogā ||107|| (55) micchāiṭṭī ṇiyamā uvaiṭṭaṃ pavayaṇaṃ ṇa saddahadi | saddahadi asambhāvaṃ uvaiṭuṃ vā aṇuvaiṭuṃ || 108 ||

kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [11 darśanamoha-kṣapaṇādhikāra (58) micchattavedaṇīe kamme ovaṭṭidammi sammatte |
khavaṇāe paṭṭhavago jahaṇṇago teulessāe ||111|| (59) aṃtomuhuttamaddha daṃsaṇamohassa ṇiyamasā khavago |
khīṇe deva-maṇusse siyā vi ṇāmāugo baṃdho ||112|| __ mithyātvavedanīyakarmake samyaktvaprakṛtimeṃ apavartita arthāt saṃkramita kara dene para jīva darśanamohakī kṣapaṇākā prasthāpaka kahalātā hai | darśanamohakī kṣapaṇāke prasthāpakako jaghanya tejoleśyāmeṃ vartamāna honā cāhie ||111||
viśeṣārtha-darśanamohakī kṣapaṇā karaneko udyata hue jīvake 'prasthāpaka' saṃjñā kaba prāpta hotī hai, isa bātake vatalāneke lie isa gāthāsūtrakā avatāra huā hai | darśanamohakī kṣapaṇāke lie udyata jīva jaba mithyātvaprakṛtike sarva dravyako samyagmidhyātvame saṃkramaṇa kara detā hai aura usake paścāt jaba samyagmithyātvake sarva dravyako samyaktvaprakṛtime saṃkramaṇa karatā hai, taba use 'prasthāpaka' yaha saṃjñā prāpta hotī hai | gāthāsūtrameṃ samyagmithyātvake pṛthak ullekha na honekā kāraṇa yaha hai ki mithyātvake saṃkrānta dravyako apane bhītara dhāraṇa karanevāle samyagmithyātvako hī yahaॉpara 'mithyātvavedanīya' nāmase kahā gayā hai| yadyapi adhaḥpravṛtta karaṇake prathama samayase hī 'prasthāpaka' saṃjñā prāraṃbha ho jātī hai, tathāpi yahā~ antadīpakakī apekṣā ukta saṃjñākā nirdeśa samajhanā cāhie, arthāt yahaॉtaka vaha prasthāpaka kahalātā hai| gāthāke caturtha caraṇa-dvārā leśyākā vidhāna kiyā gayā hai, jisakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki tīnoṃ śubha leśyāome vartamāna jīva darśanamohakī kṣapaṇākā prāraṃbha karate haiṃ| yadi koī atyanta maṃda viśuddhivālā jīva bhī darśanamohakā kṣapaṇa prāraṃbha kare to use bhī kamase kama tejoleśyāke jaghanya aṃśamai to vartamāna honā hī cāhie, kyoki kṛṣṇādi aśubha leśyāoṃmeṃ kṣapaṇākā prārambha sarvathā asaṃbhava hai|
antarmuhartakāla taka darśanamohakā niyamase kṣapaṇa karatā hai | darśanamohake kṣīṇa ho jānepara deva aura manuṣyagati-sambandhī nāmakarmakī prakṛtiyoṃkā aura āyukarmakā syāt bandha karatā hai aura syāt vandha nahīṃ bhī karatā hai ||112||
viśeṣārtha-isa gāthāke pūrvādhase yaha sūcita kiyā gayā hai ki darśanamohanīyakarmakī kṣapaṇākā kāla antarmuhūrta hī hai, na isase kama hai aura na adhika hai | gāthāke uttarārdhase yaha sūcita kiyā gayā hai ki darśanamohake kṣīṇa ho jānepara vaha kina-kina karmaprakṛtiyoṃkā vandha karatā hai| darśanamohake kṣīṇa ho jānepara yadi vaha tithaṃca yā manuṣyagatimeṃ vartamāna hai, to devagati-sambandhī hī nāmakarmakī prakṛtiyokā tathā devāyukā vandha karatā hai | aura yadi vaha deva yā narakagatime vartamāna hai, to manuṣyagati-sambandhī hī nāmakarmakī prakṛtiyoṃkā tathā manuṣyāyukā vandha karatā hai| gāthā-paṭhita 'syāt' padase yaha sūcita kiyā gayā hai

aura palyopamake saṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgamātra darśanamohanīyakarmake sthitisattva śeṣa raha jānepara dūrāpakṛṣṭi nāmakī sthiti hotī hai | tatpaścāt śepa bace hue sthitisattvake asaṃkhyāta vahubhāgoko sthitikāṃḍakarūpase ghāta karaneke lie grahaṇa karatā hai ||41-51||
viśeṣārtha-darśanamohako kṣapaṇā karanevāle jīvake anivṛttikaraṇake kālame darśanamohanīyakarmake sthitisattvake cāra parva yā vibhāga hote haiṃ, jinameṃ kramaśaḥ sthitisattva kamatī hotā huā calā jātā hai| inamese prathama parvame darśanamohakā sthitisattva sāgaropamalakṣapṛthaktva rahatā hai| dūsare parvameṃ ghaṭakara palyopamapramāṇa rahatā hai| tīsare parvame dūrāpakṛṣṭipramāṇa arthāt raha jātā hai | dūrāpakṛṣṭikā artha yaha hai ki palyapramāṇa sthitisattvase atyanta dūra taka apakarpaṇakara arthāt sthitiko ghaṭāte-ghaṭāte jaba vaha palyake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa raha jāya, aise savase antima sthitisattvako dūrāpakṛṣṭi kahate haiṃ| dūrāpakṛṣṭikā dūsarā artha yaha bhī kiyā gayā hai ki isa sthalase āge avaśiṣṭa sthitisattvake asaṃkhyātavahubhāgoko grahaṇa karake eka-eka sthitikāṃḍakaghāta hotā hai| yaha dūrāpakṛṣṭirūpa sthitikāṃḍakaghāta eka-vikalparūpa hai yā aneka-vikalparūpa hai, isa praśnakā uttara kitane hī ācāryoṃke matase eka-vikalparūpa diyā gayā hai, arthāt ve kahate haiṃ ki āge āvalīpramāṇa sthitisattva rahanetaka sthitikāṃḍakaghātakā pramāṇa sarvatra samāna hī rahatā hai| parantu jayadhavalākārane isa matakā khaṃḍana karake yaha sayuktika siddha kiyā
