64. eto pāe to muhuttigaṃ dvidikhaṃḍayaṃ | 65. apuvyakaraṇassa paḍhamasamayādo pāe jāva carimaṃ palidovamassa asaṃkhejjabhāgaṭṭi dikhaṃḍayaṃ ti edammi kāle jaṃ padesaggamoka māṇo sanvarahassāe āvaliyabāhiradvidīe padesaggaṃ dedi taṃ thovaṃ | samayutarāe dvidīe jaṃ padesaggaṃ dedi tamasaṃkhejjaguṇaṃ | evaṃ jāvaṃ guṇase ḍisīsayaṃ tāva asaṃkhejjaguṇaṃ, tado guṇaseḍisīsayādo uvarimāṇaṃtaradvidīe padesaggamasaṃkhejjaguṇahīṇaṃ, tado visesahīṇaṃ | sesāsu vi dvidīsu visesahīṇaṃ ceva, ṇatthi guṇagāraparāvatī' | 66. jādhe aṭṭhavāsaṭṭhidigaṃ saṃtakammaṃ sampattarasa tādhe pāe sammattassa aṇubhāgassa aṇusamaya ovaṇā | eso tāva eko kiriyāparivatto | 67. aṃtomuhuttigaṃ carimaṭṭhidikhaṃḍayaṃ | 68. tādhe pāe ovaṭṭijjamāṇāsu ṭṭhidīsu udaye thovaṃ padesagaṃ dijade | hī samyaktvaprakṛtikā sthitisattva āṭha varṣapramāṇa hotā hai | isī samaya vaha 'darśanamohanīyakṣapaka' kahalātā hai || 60-63||
cūrṇisū0 - isa pāye para arthāt 'darśanamohanīya-kṣapaka' yaha saṃjñā prāpta honepara antamuhūrtaṃ pramāṇavālā sthitikāṃḍaka ārambha hotā hai | apūrvakaraṇake prathama samaya se lekara palyo - pamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgavāle sthitikāṃḍaka taka isa kālameṃ jisa pradeśākā apakarṣaṇa karatā huā sabase hrasva udadyāvalīse bāhirī sthitime jo pradeśāgra detā hai, vaha sabase kama hai | isase eka samaya adhika sthitimeṃ jisa pradeśāko detā hai, vaha asaṃkhyātaguṇita hai | isase 'do samaya adhika sthiti meṃ asaṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśāyako detā 1) isa prakāra guṇaśreṇī śīrṣa taka asaṃkhyātaguṇita pradeśāko detā hai | tatpaścāt guṇaśreṇīśīrṣakase uparima- anantara sthitimeṃ asaṃkhyātaguṇita hīna pradeśāko detā hai | tatpaścāt viśeṣa hīna pradeśātrako detā hai | isa prakāra śeṣa sarva sthitiyo meṃ bhī viśeṣa -hīna viśeṣa-hīna hī pradeśāya ko detā hai | yahaॉpara kahīṃ bhī guṇakārameṃ yā kisī kriyāviśeṣaseṃ koī parivartana nahīṃ hotā hai | jisa samaya samyaktvaprakṛtikā sthitisattva āṭha varṣapramāṇa raha jātā hai, usa samaya samyaktva prakṛti ke anubhāgakī pratisamaya apavartanā hotī hai | taba yaha eka kriyāviśeṣarūpa parivartana hotā hai | isī samaya antima sthitikāṃḍakakā āyāma antarmuhūrtapramāṇa hotā hai, arthāt jo pahalese dūrāpakṛṣṭise lekara itanī dūra taka palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramāṇavālā sthitikāṃḍaka calā ā rahā thā, vaha sthitikāṃḍaka isa samaya saṃkhyāta āvalī āyāmavāle antarmuhūrta - pramāṇa ho jātā hai | yaha eka dūsarā kriyā-parivartana hai | usa samaya apavartana kī jāne - vālī sthitiyo meṃ se udaya meṃ alpa pradeśāyako detā hai | usase anantara samaya meṃ asaṃkhyāta -
1 edammi niruddhakāle dijamāṇassa dissamāṇassa vā padesaggassa aṇataraparūvido caiva guṇagārakamo, tthitattha aṇṇā ripeṇa kameṇa guṇagārapavṛtti ttija vṛtta hoi | guṇagāro ṇāma kiriyābhedo, so ṇatthi tti vā jāṇavaṇaṭṭha 'ṇatthi guṇagāraparavattī' idi sutte ṇiddiṭṭha | jayadha0

cūrṇi sū0 – deśavirata nāmaka saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi anuyogadvārameṃ eka sūtragāthā hai | vaha isa prakāra hai || 1-2||
saṃyamāsaṃyama arthāt deśasaṃyamakī labdhi, tathā cāritra arthāt sakalasaṃyamakī labdhi, pariṇāmoṃkī uttarottara vṛddhi, aura pūrva baddha karmoṃkī upaśāmanā isa anuyogadvārameṃ varṇana karane yogya hai || 115 ||
viśeṣārtha - vāstavame yaha gāthā saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi aura saṃyamalabdhi nāmaka do adhikāroṃme nibaddha hai, jaisā ki gāthāsūtrakāra svayaṃ hī granthake prārambhame kaha āye haiṃ | parantu yahaॉpara saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhike svatantra adhikāra me kahanekī vivakṣāse cūrṇikārane sāmānyase aisā kaha diyā hai ki isa anuyogadvāra meṃ eka gāthā pratibaddha hai, kyoki dono anuyogadvāroṃkā eka sātha varṇana kiyā nahīṃ jā sakatā thā | hiṃsādi pāpoke eka deśa tyāgako saṃyamāsaṃyama kahate haiṃ | saṃyamāsaṃyamake ghātaka apratyākhyānāvaraṇa kapāyake udadyābhāvase prāpta honevālī pariṇāmokī viśuddhiko saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi kahate haiṃ | hiṃsādi sarva pāpoke sarvathā tyāgako sakalasaṃyama kahate haiṃ | sakalasaṃyamake ghātaka pratyākhyānāvaraṇa kaṣāyake udayābhāva se upalabdha honevālī viśuddhiko saṃyamalabdhi kahate hai | ina donomeṃse prakṛta anuyogadvārame kevala saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhikā hī varṇana kiyā jāyagā | alabdha- pūrva saṃyamāsaṃyama yā saṃyamalabdhike prāpta honeke prathama samayase lekara antarmuhūrta kāla taka pratisamaya uttarottara anantaguṇita kramase pariṇāmokī viśuddhi-vṛddhiko 'vaḍḍāvaḍḍī' vṛddhāpavṛddhi yā 'baḍha़āvaḍha़ī' kahate haiṃ | deśacāritra yā sakalacāritrake pratibandhaka, pūrva-vaddha karmoṃke anudayarūpa abhāvako yahā~ 'upaśāmanā' nāmase grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai | isake cāra bheda haiṃ- prakṛti - upaśāmanā, sthiti - upaśāmanā, anubhāga-upaśāmanā aura pradeśopaśāmanā | deśasaṃyama aura sakalasaṃyamake ghāta karanevālī prakṛtiyokī upaśāmanāko prakṛti-upaśāmanā kahate haiṃ | inhī prakṛtiyoṃkī, athavā sabhī karmoṃ kī anta:koḍa़ākoḍa़īse ūparakī sthitiyoke udadyābhāvako sthiti upaśāmanā kahate haiṃ | cāritra ke avarodhaka

nokaṣāya, inamese eka bhī kapāyake udaya honese saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi kṣāyopaśamika siddha hotī hai | ( phira jahā~ teraha kaṣāyokā udaya hove, vahā~ to niyamase vaha kṣāyopaśamika hī hogī| ) ||86-90|| viśeṣārtha - saṃyamāsaṃ yamalabdhi kṣāyikabhāva hai, kṣāyopaśamikabhāva hai, athavā auda"yika bhāva hai ? isa prakārakī śaṃkākā uparyukta sūtroṃse ūhāpoha pūrvaka samādhāna kiyā gayā hai | usakā khulāsā yaha hai ki saṃyatāsaṃyatake apratyākhyānāvaraṇa kaṣāyakā to udaya hotā nahīṃ hai, ataḥ saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhiko audayikabhāva nahīṃ mānā jā sakatā hai | yadi kahā jāya ki saṃyatāsaṃyata ke pratyākhyānāvaraṇa kapāyakā udaya rahatā hai, ataḥ use audayika māna lenā cāhie ? to cūrṇikāra isa āśaṃkākā samādhāna karate haiṃ ki pratyākhyānāvaraṇa kapāya to saṃyamāsaṃyamakā āvaraṇa yā ghāta ādi kucha bhī karanemeṃ asamartha hai, kyoki usakā kārya saṃyamakā ghāta karanā hai, na ki saṃyamāsaṃyamakā | isalie usake udaya honepara bhī saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhiko audayika nahīṃ mānā jā sakatā hai | yahā~ anantānubandhīke udayakī to saṃbhāvanā hī nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki usakā udaya dūsare guṇasthānameṃ hī vicchinna ho cukā hai | ataeva pāriśeṣanyāya se saṃyatāsaṃyata ke cāro saṃjvalano aura navo nokaṣāyokā udaya rahatā hai | ye sabhī kaṣāya deśaghātī haiṃ, ataeva unakā udaya saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhiko bhī deśaghātī vanā detā hai | yahā~ deśaghātī saṃjvalanādi kaṣāyoke udayase utpanna honevāle saṃyamāsaṃyama-labdhirūpa kāryameṃ saṃjvalanādi kaṣāyarūpa kāraṇakā upacāra karake use deśaghātī kahā gayā hai | isa prakāra cāra saṃjvalana aura nava nokaṣāyoke sarvadhātī spardhakoṃke udayābhāvī kṣayase, tathā inhīṃke deśaghātispardhaka ke udayase saṃyamāsaṃyama labdhiko kṣāyopaśamika mānā gayā hai | yadi saṃyatāsaṃyata pratyākhyānāvaraṇakaṣāyakā vedana karate hue saṃnvalanādi śeṣa kapāyokā vedana na kare, to saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhiko kṣāyika mānanā paḍa़egā ? aisā kahanekā abhiprāya yaha hai ki saṃyatāsaṃyatake saṃyamāsaṃyamako ghāta karanevāle apratyākhyānāvaraṇa kaṣāyakā to udaya hai hī nahīṃ | aura pratyākhyānāvaraṇa kaṣāyakā udaya hai, so vaha saṃyamakā bhale hī ghāta kare, para saṃyamāsaṃyamakā vaha upaghāta yā anugraha kucha bhī na karanemeṃ samartha nahīṃ hai | ataḥ pratyākhyānāvaraṇakaṣāyakā vedana karate hue yadi saṃjvalanādi kaṣāyokā udaya na mānā jāya, to saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi kṣāyika siddha hotī hai | kintu āgamameṃ use kṣāyika mānā nahīṃ gayā hai, ataḥ asaṃdigdharūpase vaha kṣāyopaśamika hī siddha hotī hai |

1. laddhī tahā carittassetti aṇiogaddāre puvvaṃ gamaṇijjaṃ suttaṃ | 2. taṃ | jahā | 3. jā ceva saṃjamāsaṃjame maṇidā gāhā sā ceva ettha vi kāyavvā | 4.carimasamayaadhāpavattakaraṇe cattāri gāhāo | 5. taṃ jahā | 6. saṃjamaṃ paḍivajjamāṇassa pariṇāmo keriso bhave0 (1)| 7. kāṇi vā putvavaddhāṇi (2)| 8. ke aṃse jhīyade puvvaṃ0 ( 3.)| 9. kiṃ ḍidiyāṇi kammāṇi0 ( 4 ) | 10. edāo suttagāhāo vihāsiyūṇa tado sajamaṃ paḍivajjamāṇagassa uvakkamavidhivihāsā |
13 saṃyamalabdhi-arthādhikāra
cūrṇisū0-cāritrakī labdhi arthāt saṃyamalabdhi nāmaka anuyogadvārame pahale gāthārūpa sūtra jñātavya hai | vaha isa prakāra hai-jo gāthā pahale saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhi nāmaka anuyogadvārameṃ kahī gaī hai, vahī yahā~ bhī prarūpaṇa karanā cāhie ||1-3||
viśeṣārtha-śrīguṇadharācāryane saṃyamāsaṃyama aura saṃyamalabdhi ina dono anuyogadvāroṃkā varṇana karanevālī vaha eka hī gāthā kahī hai| usa gāthāmeṃ saṃyamalabdhikī sūcanāmātra dekara pariṇāmoṃkī uttarottara vṛddhi aura pūrva baddha karmoṃkī upaśāmanākā ullekha kara unakī prarūpaṇākā saṃketa kiyā gayā hai| ataeva saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhimeṃ varṇita prakārase yahā~ bhī unakā varṇana karanā cāhie| yahaॉpara kevala saṃyamāsaṃyamalabdhike sthānapara saṃyamalabdhike nāmakā ullekha karanā āvaśyaka hai |
__cūrṇisa0-saṃyamako grahaṇa karaneke lie udyata jīvake adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇake antima samayameṃ pūrvokta cāro prasthāpana-gāthāe~ jñātavya haiṃ| ve isa prakāra haiṃ saṃyamako prāpta karanevāle jīvakā pariṇāma kaisā hotā hai, usake kaunasā yoga, kaṣāya, upayoga, leśyā aura veda hotā hai ? (1)| saṃyamako prāpta karanevāle jīvake pūrvabaddha karma kauna-kaunase haiṃ aura kauna-kaunase navīna karma baॉdhatā hai ? usake kitane karma udayame ā rahe haiṃ aura kitanokī udīraṇā karatā hai ? (2)| kauna-kauna karma usake baṃdha yā udayase vyucchinna hote hai aura kaba kahaॉpara antara karake vaha saṃyamalabdhiko prāpta karatā hai ? (3)| usake kisa kisa sthitivāle karma hote haiṃ aura vaha kisa kisa anubhāgameṃ kisakā apavartana karake kisa sthānako prāpta karatā hai ? (4)| ina cāro sūtra-gāthāokī vibhāṣā karake tatpaścāta saṃyamako prāpta honevāle jīvake upakramavidhikī vibhāṣā karanā cāhie ||4-10||

ই 46. edesiṃ laddhiṭṭhāṇāṇamapyābahuaṃka | 47. taṃ jahā | 48. savvatthovāṇi paḍivādaṭṭhāṇāṇi | 49. uppādayaṭṭhāṇāṇi asaṃkhejjaguṇāṇi | 50. laṭṭhiāṇāṇi asaṃkhejjaguṇāṇi | 51. tivva-maṃdadāe savvamaṃdāṇubhāgaṃ micchattaṃ gacchamāṇassa jahaṇṇayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇaṃ | 52. tassevukassayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 53. asaṃjadasammattaṃ gacchamāṇassa jahaṇṇayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 54. tassebukkassayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 55. saṃjamāsaṃjamaṃ gacchamāṇassa jahaṇṇayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 56. tassevukkassayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 57. kammabhūmiyassa paḍivajjamāṇayassa jahaṇṇayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ | 58. akammabhūmiyassa paḍivajjamāṇayassa jahaṇṇayaṃ saṃjamaṭṭhāṇamaṇaṃtaguṇaṃ |
viśeṣārtha-yahaॉ sarva hī padase asaṃkhyāta lokapramāṇa bhedavāle sabhī pratipātasthāna, pratipadyamānasthāna aura apratipāta-apratipadyamānasthānokā grahaṇa karanā cāhie | athavā pratipāta aura pratipadyamānasthānoko choḍa़kara śeṣa sarva apratipāta-apratipadyamāna sthānoṃko labdhisthāna jānanā cāhie|
cūrṇisū0-aba ina labdhisthānokā alpabahutva kahate hai| vaha isa prakāra hai-saṃyamalabdhike pratipātasthāna sabase kama hai| pratipātasthānose utpādakasthāna asaṃkhyātaguṇita hai aura utpādakasthānoṃse labdhisthāna asaṃkhyātaguṇita hai ||46-50|| - cūrṇisū0-aba labdhisthānokā tīvra-mandatā-viṣayaka alpabahutva kahate haiṃ-mithyātvako jānevāle carama samayavartī saṃyatake jaghanya saṃyamasthāna sabase manda anubhāgavālā hotā hai| isase usake hī, arthāt mithyātvako jānevāle jīvake utkṛṣṭa labdhisthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase asaṃyatasamyaktvako prāpta karanevāle jīvakā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase usakā hī utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase saṃyamāsaṃyamako prāpta honevāle jīvakā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase usakā hī utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase saṃyamako prāpta karanevāle karmamūbhija manuṣyakā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase saṃyamako prāpta karanevāle akarmabhūbhija manuṣyakā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai ||51-58||
viśeṣārtha-ūpara jo akarmabhūbhija manuṣyake saṃyamalabdhisthāna batalāye gaye haiṃ, so vahaॉpara akarmabhūbhijakā artha bhogabhūmija na karake mlecchakhaṃḍaja karanā cāhie, kyoki mlecchoṃmeṃ sādhāraṇataḥ dharma-karmakī pravṛtti na pāī jānese unhe akarmabhūmija kahā gayā hai| ataeva yahā~ bharata, airāvata yā videhasambandhī karmabhūmike madhyavartī sarva mlecchakhaṃḍokā grahaṇa karanā cāhie| yahā~ yaha śaṃkā kī jā sakatī hai ki jaba 'dharma-karmabahibhūtā ityamī
*tāmrapatravālī pratime isase āge 'ettha duvihamappābahuaṃ laṭṭhiāṇasaṃkhāvisayaṃ tivvamaṃdadāvisayaṃ ca | tattha tivva-maṃdadāe appāvahuasuvari kassāmo' itanā ṭīkākā aśa mī sūtrarūpase mudrita hai | ( dekho pṛ0 1802-1803)

cūrṇimū0-saṃyamako prāpta honevāle akarmabhūmijake jaghanya saṃyamasthānase saṃyamako prāpta honevāle usakā hī arthāt akarmabhūmija manuṣyakā utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase saṃyamako prāpta karanevāle karmabhūmijakā utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase parihāraviśuddhi-saṃyatakā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase usakā hī utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai| isase sāmāyika-chedopasthāpanāśuddhi-saṃyatokā utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase sūkṣmasāmparāyaśuddhi-saṃyatokā jaghanya saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase sūkṣmasāmparāyaśuddhi -saṃyatokā utkṛṣṭa saṃyamasthāna anantaguṇita hai | isase vītarāgachadmastha aura kevalīkā ajaghanya-anutkṛṣṭa cāritra labdhisthāna anantaguṇita hai ||59-66||
viśeṣārtha-vahā~ yaha śaṃkā kī jā sakatī hai ki vītarāgake jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa cāritralabdhi kyoṃ nahīṃ batalāī gaī ? isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki kapāyoṃke abhāva ho jānese unakī cāritra labdhime jaghanyapanā yā utkṛṣṭapanā saṃbhava nahī hai| ataeva vītarāgake sarvadā eka rūpase avasthita hī cāritralabdhi pāī jātī hai| yadi kahā jāya ki upaśāntakapāyavītarāga. chadmasthakā patana avaśya hī hotā hai, ataeva patanakālameṃ usake yathākhyātacāritralabdhikā jaghanya aṃśa kyo na mānā jāya ? aura isī prakārase kṣīṇakapāya yā kevalīke ūpara caḍha़nekī avasthāmeṃ cāritralabdhikā utkṛṣṭa aṃśa kyoṃ na mānā jāya ? to isakā samādhāna yaha hai ki pariṇāmokī tīvratā-mandatākā kāraṇa kapāyokā udaya hai| upaśāntakaṣāya, kṣīṇakapāya aura kevalīke kaṣāyokā sarvathā abhāva hai, ataeva unake pariṇāmoṃ meṃ tīvratā yā mandatākā honā

1. caritamohaṇīyassa uvasāmaṇāe puvvaṃ gamaṇijja' sutaṃ | 2. taṃ jahā | (63) uvasāmaṇā kadividhā uvasāmo kassa kassa kammassa | kaṃ kamma uvasaṃtaṃ aṇauvasaṃtaṃ ca kaṃ kammaṃ || 116 || (64) kadibhāvasāmijjadi saṃkamaṇamudīraṇā ca kadibhāgo |
kadibhāgaṃ vā baṃdhadi hidi- aṇubhāge padesagge || 117 || (65) ke ciramuvasāmijjadi saṃkamaṇamudīraṇā ca kevaciraṃ |

14 cāritramohopaśāmanā - arthādhikāra
cūrṇisū0 - cāritramohanīyakī upaśāmanāmeṃ pahale gāthāsūtra jānane yogya hai | vaha isa prakāra hai || 1-2 ||
upaśāmanā kitane prakārakī hotī hai ? upaśama kisa-kisa karmakā hotā hai ? kisa-kisa avasthā - viśeṣameṃ kauna-kauna karma upaśānta rahatā hai aura kauna-kauna karma anupaśānta rahatā hai ? || 116 ||
cāritramohanīyakarmakī sthiti, anubhāga aura pradeśāgroṃkā kisa samaya kitanā bhāga upaśamita karatā hai, kitanā bhāga saṃkramaṇa aura udīraṇā karatā hai, tathā kitanā bhāga bā~dhatā hai ? ||117||
cāritra mohanīyakarmakī prakṛtiyoṃ kā kitane kāla taka upaśamana karatā hai, saṃkramaṇa aura udīraṇā kitane kāla taka hotī hai, tathā kauna karma kitane kāla taka upaśānta yā anupaśānta rahatā hai ? ||118||
kisa avasthāmeṃ kauna karaṇa vyucchinna ho jātā hai aura kauna karaṇa anyucchinna rahatā hai ? tathā kisa avasthā viśeṣameṃ kauna karaṇa upaśānta yā anupaśānta rahatā hai ? ||119 ||

kasāya pāhuḍa supta [ 14 cāritramoha-upaśamanādhikāra vedasammāhaṭṭī aṇaṃtāṇubaṃdhī avisaṃjoedūṇa kasāe uvasāmedu ṇo ubaṭṭhādi | 5. so tāva putrameva arṇatāṇubaṃdhī visaṃjoedi | 6. tado aṇaṃtāṇuvaṃdhī visaṃjoeṃtassa jāṇi karaṇāṇi tāṇi savvāṇi paruveyavvāṇi | 7. taṃ jahā | 8. adhāpavatta karaṇamaputrakaraṇamaṇiyadvikaraṇaṃ ca | 9. adhāpavattakaraṇe ṇatthi vidighādo [ aṇubhāgavādo ] vā guṇaseḍī vā | [ guṇasaṃkamo vā ] 10. apuvyakaraṇe atthi vididhādo aṇubhāgadhādo guṇaseḍhī ca guṇasaṃkamo vi | 11. aṇiyaṭṭikaraṇe vi edāṇi ceva, aṃtarakaraṇaṃ ṇatthi | 12. esā tāva jo atānubaṃdhī visaṃjoedi tassa samāsaparūvaṇā |

679 17. apuvakaraṇassa jaṃ paḍhamasamae hidisaṃtakammaṃ taṃ carimasamae saṃkhejjaguṇahīṇaṃ | 18. daṃsaṇamohaṇīya uvasāmaṇaaṇiyaṭṭiaddhāe saṃkhejjesu bhāgesu gadesu sammattassa asaṃkhejjāṇaṃ samayapavaddhāṇamudīraṇā | 19. tado aṃtomuhutteṇa dasaṇamohaṇīyassa aṃtaraṃ karedi |
cūrṇisū0-apūrvakaraṇake prathama samayame jo sthitisattva hotā hai, vaha apūrvakaraṇake antima samayame usase saṃkhyātaguṇita hīna ho jātā hai| ( isī prakāra anivṛttikaraṇake prathama samayameṃ jo sthitisattva hotā hai, usase antima samayame vaha saṃkhyātaguṇita hīna ho jātā hai |) darśanamohanīyake upaśamana karanevāle jīvake anivṛttikaraṇakālake saṃkhyāta bhāgoke vyatīta honepara samyaktvaprakṛtike asaṃkhyāta samayaprabaddhokī udīraṇā hotī hai| tatpaścāt eka antarmuhūrta ke dvārā darśanamohanīyakā antara karatā hai ||17-19||
viśeṣārtha-darśanamohakā antarakaraṇako karanevālā jīva samyaktvaprakṛtikī antamuhūrtapramāṇa sthitiko choḍa़kara, tathā mithyātva aura samyagmithyātvakī udayāvalīko choḍa़kara śeṣa sthitikā antara karatā hai| isa antarakālīna sthitiyoke utkīraṇa kiye jānevāle pradeśāgrako bandhakā abhāva ho jānese dvitīya sthitimeṃ saṃkramaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai, kintu sarva dravyako lākara sabhyaktvaprakṛtikī prathamasthitime nikṣipta karatā hai| tathā samyaktvaprakṛtike dvitīya sthitisambandhī pradeśāgrakā utkīraṇa kara apanī prathamasthitime guṇaśreṇīke rūpase nikṣipta karatā hai | isī prakāra mithyātva aura samyagmithyātvake bhī dvitīyasthitike pradeśāgrako utkīraṇa kara samyaktvaprakṛtikī prathamasthitime detā hai, tathā anutkīryamāṇa sthitiyome bhī detā hai, kintu apanī antara-sthitiyomeṃ nahīṃ detā hai| samyaktvaprakṛtikī prathamasthitike samāna sthitiyoṃme sthita mithyātva aura samyagmithyātva prakṛtiyoke udayāvalīke bāhira sthita pradeśāgrako samyaktvaprakṛtikī prathama sthitiyome saṃkramaṇa karatā hai| isa prakārase yaha krama antarakaraṇakī dvicarama phālīke prāpta hone taka rahatā hai| punaḥ antima phāla ke nipatanakālame mithyātva aura samyagmithyātvakī sava antarasthitiyoke pradeśāgrako samyaktvaprakṛtikī prathamasthitimeṃ saṃkramaṇa karatā hai | isī prakāra samyaktvaprakṛtike caramaphālisambandhī dravyako anyatra saṃkramita nahīṃ karatā hai, kintu apanī prathamasthitime hī saṃkramita karatā hai | dvitīyasthitike pradeśāgrako bhī prathamasthitimeṃ hī taba taka nikṣipta karatā hai, jaba taka ki prathamasthitimeṃ āvalī aura pratyāvalī śeṣa rahatī haiṃ| isake paścāt āgāla aura pratyāgālakā kārya samāpta ho jātā hai| isa samaya guṇaśreṇīrūpa vinyāsa nahīṃ hotā hai, kintu pratyāvalīse hī udīraṇā hotī rahatī hai| eka samaya-adhika āvalīke śeṣa raha jānepara samyaktvaprakṛtikī jaghanya sthiti-udīraṇā hotī hai| tatpaścāt prathamasthitike antima samayameṃ anivṛttikaraṇakā kāla samāpta ho jātā hai aura tadanantara samayameṃ vaha samyagdṛṣṭi ho jātā hai| usa samaya prathamopaśamasamyaktvakī prāptike samāna antarmuhūrtakāla taka kyā bhithyātvakā guṇasaṃkramaṇa yahā~ bhī

kasāya pāhuḍa susta [14 cāritramoha-upaśāmanādhikāra 20. sammattassa paḍhamadvidīe jhīṇāe jaṃ taṃ micchattassa padesaggaṃ sammattasammāmicchatte su guṇasaṃkameṇa [ ṇa ] saṃkamadi | 21. paramadāe sammattamuppādayamāṇassa jo guṇasaṃkaraṇa pūraṇakālo tado saṃkhejjaguṇaṃ kālamimo uvasaṃtadaṃsaṇamohaṇīo visohīe vaḍvadi | 22. teṇa paraṃ hāyadi vā vaḍḍhadi vā avaṭṭhāyadi vā | 23. tahā ceva tāva uvasaṃtadasaṇamohaṇijjo asāda aradi-soga-ajasagitti-ādīsu baṃdhaparāvattasahassāṇi kādaṇa* tado kasāe uvasāyedaṃ kacce adhāpavattakaraṇassa pariṇāmaṃ pariṇamaha | 24. jaṃ aṇaṃtāṇuvaṃdhī visaṃjoeṃteṇa hadaṃ dasaṇamohaṇīyaṃ ca uvasāmeṃteṇa hadaṃ kamyaṃ tamuvarihadaṃ |

cūrṇisū0-samyaktvaprakṛtikī prathama sthitike kṣīṇa honepara jo mithyātvakā pradeśāgra avaśiṣṭa rahatā hai, vaha samyaktvaprakṛti aura samyagmithyātvame guṇasaṃkramaṇase saṃkrānta nahīṃ karatā hai, arthāt jisa prakāra prathama vāra samyaktvake utpādana karanevāle jīvake guṇasaṃkramaṇa hotā hai, usa prakārase yahaॉpara guṇasaṃkramaṇa nahīṃ hotā hai, kintu isake kevala vidhyātasaṃkramaṇa hī hotā hai| prathama vāra samyaktvako utpanna karanevāle jīvakā jo guṇasaṃkramaṇase pūraṇakāla hai, usase saṃkhyātaguṇita kāla taka yaha upaśāntadarśanamohanīya jīva viśuddhise baḍha़tā hai| isake paścāt vaha ( saṃkleśa aura viśuddhirūpa pariṇāmoke yogase ) kabhī viśuddhise hīnatāko prāpta hotā hai, kabhī vṛddhiko prāpta hotā hai aura kabhī avasthita pariṇāmarūpa rahatā hai| punaḥ vahī upaśāntadarśanamohanīya jīva asātā, arati, śoka, aura ayaśaḥkīrti ādi prakṛtiyome sahasroṃ bandha-parāvartana karake arthāt sahasro vāra pramattasaṃyatase apramattasaṃyata aura apramattasaṃyatase pramattasaṃyata ho karake, tatpaścāt kapāyoke upaśamāneke lie adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇake pariṇāmase pariṇata hotā hai| jo karma anantānuvandhī kapāyake visaṃyojana karanevālene naṣṭa kiyā; vaha 'hata' kahalātā hai aura jo karma darśanamohanīyake upaśamana karanevāleke dvārā naṣṭa kiyā jātā hai, vaha upari-hata karma kahalātā hai ||20-24||
cūrṇisū0-isa samaya kapāyoke upaśamana karanevāle jīvake jo adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇa hotā hai, usame sthitighāta, anubhāgaghāta aura guṇaśreṇī nahīṃ hotī hai | kevala anantaguṇī viśuddhise pratisamaya baḍha़tā rahatā hai| isa adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇakā bhī vahī lakṣaṇa hai, jo ki pahale darśanamohakī upaśamanāke samaya prarūpaṇa kara āye haiṃ | tatpaścāt adhaḥpravṛttakaraṇake antima samayame
tāmrapatravālī pratimeṃ 'kādaṇa' padase āge 'jahā aṇatāṇubaṃdhī visaṃjoedraṇa satthāṇe padido asādādivaṃdhapāoggo hodi' itanā ṭokāśa bhī sūtrarūpase mudrita hai| ( dekho pṛ0 1815 ) |

34. jo khīṇadaṃsaṇamohaṇijjo kasāya-uvasāmago tassa khīṇadaṃsaṇamohaṇijjassa kasāya ucasāmaṇāe apuvyakaraṇe paḍhamaṭṭi dikhaṃḍayaṃ ṇiyamā palidovamassa saṃkhejjadibhāgo | 35. dvidibaṃgheṇa jamosaradi so vipalidovamassa saṃkhejjadibhāgo | 36. asubhāṇaṃ kammāṇamaṇaṃtā bhāgā aṇubhāgakhaṃḍayaṃ | 37. ṭṭhidisaṃtakamma maṃtokoḍākoḍīe, ṭṭhidibaṃdho vi aṃtokoḍākoḍīe | 38. guṇaseḍhī ca aṃtomuhuttamettā

ye cāra sūtragāthāe~ prarūpaṇa karanā cāhie | ve isa prakāra haiṃ- " kaṣāyokā upaśama karanevāle jīvakā pariṇāma kaisā hotā hai ? kisa yoga, kaṣāya aura upayoga meṃ vartamāna, kisa leśyāse yukta aura kaunase vedavālā jīva kaṣāyokā upaśama karatā hai ( 1 ) | kaṣāyo ke upaśamana karanevāle jīvake pūrva-baddha karma kauna - kaunase hai aura aba kauna - kaunase navīna karmāśoko bā~dhatā hai | kaṣāyoke upaśāmakake kauna-kauna prakṛtiyā~ udadyāvalīme praveśa karatī haiṃ aura kauna-kauna prakṛtiyokī vaha udīraṇā karatā hai ? 54. āugavajjāṇaṃ kammāṇaṃ ṭhidisaṃtakammamaṃtokoḍākoḍīe| 55. ṭhidibaṃdho aṃtokoḍīe sadasahassapudhattaṃ | 56. tado ṭhidikhaṃḍayasahassesu gadesu ṭhidibaṃdho sahassaputta | 57. tado aṇiyaṭṭiaddhāe saṃkhejjesu bhāgesu gadesu asaṇṇiḍidibaṃdheṇa samago ṭhidibaṃdho | 58. tado ṭhidibaṃdhapadhatte gade caduriṃdiyaṭṭhidivaṃdhasamago hidibaṃdho | pamake saṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgase hīna hotā hai | anubhāgakāṃḍaka anubhāgasattvake ananta bahubhāgapramāṇa hai | guṇaśreṇī asaṃkhyātaguṇita śreṇirūpase hotī hai aura śeṣa śeṣa dravyameṃ nikṣepa hotā hai| arthāt jisa prakārase apūrvakaraṇameṃ pratisamaya asaṃkhyātaguṇita śreṇīke dvārā udayāvalīke bāhira galita-śeṣāyāmake rūpase guṇaśreṇīkī racanā hotī hai, usī prakāra yahaॉpara bhī guṇaśreṇīkī racanā hotī hai | usī anivṛttikaraṇakālake prathama samayameṃ apraśastopaśamanākaraṇa, nidhattīkaraṇa aura nikācanākaraṇa ye tīno hī karaṇa eka sātha vyucchinna ho jāte hai ||42-53||
viśeṣārtha-jo karma utkarṣaṇa, apakarpaṇa aura para-prakṛti-saṃkramaṇake yogya hokarake bhī udayasthitimeṃ apakarṣita karaneke lie śakya na ho, arthāt jisakī udīraṇā na kī jā sake use apraśastopaśāmanākaraṇa kahate haiṃ| jisa karmakā utkarṣaṇa aura apakarpaṇa to kiyā jā sake, kintu udīraṇā arthāt udayasthitimeṃ apakarṣaṇa aura para prakṛtime saṃkramaṇa na kiyā jā sake, use nidhattīkaraṇa kahate haiṃ| jisa karmakā utkarṣaṇa, apakarpaṇa, udīraṇā aura paraprakṛti-saṃkramaṇa ye cāro hī kārya na kiye jā sakeṃ, kintu jisa rūpase use bā~dhā thā, usī rūpase vaha sattāmeṃ tadavastha rahe, use nikācanākaraṇa kahate haiṃ | ye tīno karaṇa apūrvakaraṇake antima samaya taka hote rahate haiṃ, kintu anivṛttikaraṇake prathama samayame ye tīno banda ho jāte haiṃ|
___ cūrṇisū0-usa anivṛttikaraṇake prathama samayamai āyukarmako choḍa़kara śepa sāta karmoṃkā sthitisattva antaḥkoḍa़ākoḍa़ī sāgaropamapramāṇa aura sthitibandha anta.koḍa़ī arthāta sāgaropamalakṣapṛthaktva-pramāṇa hotā hai| tatpaścāt sahasro sthitikāṃḍakoṃke vyatīta honepara sthiti bandha sāgaropama sahasrapṛthaktva raha jātā hai| tatpaścāt anivṛttikaraṇakālake saṃkhyāta bhāgoke vyatīta honepara asaṃjñī jīvokī sthitike bandhake samāna sahasra sāgaropamapramāṇa sthitivandha hotā hai| tatpaścāt sthitivandhapṛthaktvake bīta jānepara caturindriya jīvake sthitibandhake

viśeṣārtha - udaya yā anudayako prāpta sabhī kaṣāya aura nokapāyavedanīya karma - prakṛtiyokī antarase ūparakī sthiti to samāna hī hotī hai, kyoki dvitīyasthiti ke prathama niṣekakā sarvatra sadṛśarūpase avasthāna dekhā jātā hai, isalie 'ūpara samasthiti antara hai, ' aisā kahā gayā hai | kintu antarase nīcekī sthiti viṣama hotī hai, isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki anudayavatī sabhī prakṛtiyo ke sadṛśa honepara bhī udayako prāpta kisī eka saṃjvalana kaṣāya aura kisī eka vedako antarmuhūrtamātra prathamasthiti se pare antara kī prathamasthitikā hī avasthāna dekhā jātā hai | isalie prathamasthitikī visadṛśatā ke āśraya se 'nīce viṣamasthiti antara hai' aisā kahā gayā hai |
cūrṇi sū0- 0 - jaba antara utkīrṇa karatā hai, arthāt jisa samaya antarakaraṇa ārambha karatā hai, usī samaya meṃ hī anya sthitibandha bā~dhatā hai, tathā anya sthitikāṃḍaka aura anya anubhāga kāṃḍakako grahaṇa karatā hai | isa prakāra sahasro anubhāgakāṃḍakoke vyatīta honepara anya anubhāgakāṃḍaka, tathā vahī sthitikāṃḍaka, vahī sthitibandha aura antarakā utkīraṇakāla,

, kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [14 cāritramoha-upaśāmanādhikāra 135. aṃtaraṃ karamāṇamsa je kammaṃsā bajhaṃti, vedijjaṃti, tesiṃ kammāṇamaṃtaravidīo ukkīreṃto tāsi hidīṇaṃ padesaggaṃ baṃdhapayaḍīṇaṃ paḍhamahidīe ca dedi, vidiyahidīe ca dedi| 136. je kammaṃsā ṇa bajhaṃti, ṇa vedijjaṃti, tesimukkīramāṇaṃ padesaggaṃ satthāṇe ṇa dedi vajjhamāṇīṇaṃ payaḍīṇamaṇukīramāṇīsu dvidīsu dedi | 137. je kammaṃsā ṇa vajhaṃti, vedajjati ca; tesimukkīramāṇayaṃ padesaggaṃ appappaṇo paḍapaṭṭhidīe ca dedi, bajjhamāṇīṇaṃ payaḍīṇamaṇukīramāṇīsu ca hidosu dedi | 138. je kamyaṃsā ṇa vamaṃti, ṇa vedijjaṃti, tesimukkīramāṇaṃ padesaggaṃ vajjhamāṇīṇaṃ payaḍīṇamaṇukkīramāṇīsu dvidīsu dedi | 139. edeṇa kameṇa aṃtaramukkīramāṇamukkiṇṇaṃ |

141. chasu āvaliyāsu gadāsu udīraṇā ṇāma kiṃ bhaṇidaṃ hoi ? 142. vihāsā | 143. jahā ṇāma samayapabaddho baddho āvaliyādikaṃto sakko udīredumevamaṃtarādo kramake anusāra dravyake saṃkramaṇa karaneko ānupūrvī-saṃkrama kahate hai| puruṣavedake udayase caḍha़ā huā jīva strīveda aura napuṃsakavedake pradeśāgrako niyamase purupavedame saṃkrānta karatā hai| isī prakāra krodhakaṣāyake udayase caḍha़ā huā jīva puruṣaveda, chaha nokaṣāya, pratyākhyānāvaraṇa
aura apratyākhyānāvaraṇa krodhake pradeśāgrako krodhasaṃjvalanake ūpara saṃkrānta karatā hai aura kahīṃ nahīṃ | punaḥ krodhasaṃjvalana aura dono madhyama mānakaṣāyake pradeśāgrako niyamase mānasaṃjvalaname saṃkrānta karatā hai, anyatra kahīṃ nahīṃ| mānasaṃjvalanako aura dvividha madhyama māyāke pradeśāgrako niyamase māyāsaṃjvalaname nikṣipta karatā hai | māyāsaṃjvalana aura dvividha madhyama lobhake pradeśānako niyamase lobhasaṃjvalanameṃ saṃkrānta karatā hai | isa prakārake kramase honevāle saṃkramaṇako ānupūrvī-saṃkramaṇa kahate haiṃ| isa sthalake pūrva anānupūrvīse pravartamāna cāritramohanīyakī prakṛtiyokā saṃkramaṇa isa samaya isa uparyukta pratiniyata ānupūrvīse pravṛtta hotā hai, aisā yahā~ abhiprāya jānanā cāhie (1)| 'lobhakā asaṃkrama' yaha dūsarā karaṇa hai| sūtrameṃ 'lobha' aisā sāmānya nirdeśa honepara bhī yahā~ lobhase saṃjvalanalobhakā hī grahaṇa karanā cāhie | lobhake asaṃkramaṇakā artha yaha hai ki isase pūrva anānupūrvīse lobhasaṃjvalanakā śeṣa saṃjvalanakapāyome aura puruṣavedameṃ pravartamāna saṃkramaṇa isa samaya banda ho jātā hai (2) | 'mohanīyakā ekasthānīya bandha' yaha tīsarā karaṇa hai, isakā artha yaha hai ki isase pūrva mohanīyakarmakā anubhāga deśaghātī dvisthānīyarūpase baॅdhatā thā, vaha isa samaya pariṇāmoṃkī viśuddhi ke yogase haṭa kara ekasthānīya ho jātā hai (3)| 'napuṃsakavedakā prathama samaya-upaśāmaka' yaha caturtha karaṇa hai | isakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki tīno vedomese napuṃsakavedakī hī sarvaprathama isa sthalapara āyuktakaraṇake dvārā upaśāmana-kriyāmeṃ pravṛtti hotī hai (4)| 'chaha āvaliyoke vyatīta honepara udīraṇā' yaha paṃcama karaṇa hai | isakā artha āge cūrṇikāra svayaṃ hī kareṃge (5)| 'mohanīyakā ekasthānīya udaya' yaha ṣaṣṭa karaṇa hai| isakā artha yaha hai ki isase pūrva latā aura dārurūpa dvisthānīya deśaghātisvarūpase pravartamāna anubhāgakā udaya antarakaraṇake anantara hī ekasthānīya latārūpase pariṇata ho jātā hai (6) | 'mohanīyakā saṃkhyātavarṣīya sthitibandha' yaha saptama karaṇa hai| isakā artha yaha hai ki isase pūrva mohanīyakarmakā sthitibandha asaṃkhyāta vokā hotā thā| vaha kaṣāyokī mandatā yā pariṇāmokī viśuddhitāke prabhāvase ekadama ghaṭakara saṃkhyāta varṣapramāṇa raha jātā hai | kintu śepa karmoṃkāsthitivandha isa samaya bhī asaṃkhyāta varṣoṃkā hī hotā hai (7)|
. śaṃkā-chaha āvaliyoke vyatīta honepara udīraṇā hotī hai, isakā kyā abhiprāya hai ? ||141||
samādhāna-chaha āvalīkālake vyatīta honepara udīraṇā hotī hai, isakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki jisa prakāra isase pūrva adhastana sarvatra saṃsārāvasthāme ba~dhā huā samayaprabaddha

phasāya pāhuḍa sutta [14 cāritrayoda-upaśāmanādhikāra paḍhamasamayakadādo pāe jāṇi kammāṇi bajhaṃti mohaṇīyaṃ vā mohaṇīyavanjāṇi vā, tāṇi kammāṇi chasu āvaliyāsu gadāsu sakkāṇi udīredūṃ ūṇigāsu chasu āvaliyāsu ṇa sakkāṇi udīredu| 144. esā chasu ācaliyāsu gadāsu udīraṇā tti saṇṇā |
145. keṇa kāraṇeṇa chasu āvaliyāsu gadāsu udīraṇā bhavadi ? 146. ṇidarisaṇaṃ*| 147. jahā ṇāma vārasa kiṭṭīo bhave purisavedaṃ ca baṃdhai, tassa jaṃ padesaggaṃ purisavede barddha tāva āvaliyaṃ acchadi'| 148. āvaliyādikaṃ kohassa paḍhamakiṭṭīe vidiyakiṭṭīe ca saṃkāmijjadi| 149. vidiyakiṭṭīdo tamhi āvaliyādikaṃtaṃ taṃ kohassa tadiyakiṭṭīe ca māṇassa paḍhama-vidiyakiṭṭīsu ca saṃkāmijjadi | 150. māṇassa vidiyakiṭṭīdo tamhi āvaliyādikaṃtaṃ māṇassa ca tadiyakiṭṭīe māyāe āvalīpramāṇa kālake atikrānta honepara hī udīraṇā karaneke lie śakya hai, usa prakāra antara karaneke prathama samayase lekara isa sthala taka mohanīya yā mohanīyake atirikta jo karma baṃdhate haiṃ, ve karma chaha āvalīpramāṇa kālake vyatīta honepara hī udīraṇā karaneke lie śakya haiṃ, chaha āvaliyome kucha nyūnatā honepara udīraṇāke lie śakya nahīṃ haiṃ| yaha 'chaha āvaliyoke vyatīta honepara udīraṇā hotī hai' aisā kahanekā abhiprāya hai ||142-144||
śaṃkā-kisa kāraṇase chaha āvaliyoke vyatīta honepara hī udīraṇā hotī hai ? isake pūrva udīraṇā honā kyo sambhava nahīṃ hai ? ||145||
samādhāna-isa śaṃkākā samādhānātmaka nidarśana isa prakāra hai-jisa vāraha kṛṣṭivāle bhavameṃ jo purupavedako vaॉdhatā hai, usake jo pradeśāgra purupavedame baddha huā hai, vaha eka āvalīkāla taka acalarūpase rahatā hai| arthāt yaha eka āvalī svasthāname hī udīraṇāvasthāse parānmukha prāpta hotī hai| ukta vandhāvalīkālake atikrānta honepara puruṣavedake baddha pradeśāgrako saṃjvalanakrodhakī prathama kṛṣṭi aura dvitīya kṛṣṭimeṃ saṃkrānta karatā hai, ataeva vahaॉpara vaha karma-pradeśāya saṃkramaṇāvalīmātra kāla taka avicalitarūpase avasthita rahatā hai, isalie yaha dūsarī āvalī udīraṇā-paryāyase vimukha upalabdha hotī hai| vaha purupavedakā saṃkrānta pradeśāgra saṃjvalanakrodhakī prathama yā dvitīya kṛṣṭime eka āvalī taka rahakara tatpaścāt dvitīya kṛṣṭise krodhakī tṛtīya kṛṣṭimeṃ aura saṃjvalanamānakī prathama aura dvitīya kṛṣṭimeṃ saṃkrānta kiyā jātā hai, ataḥ yaha saṃkramaṇarūpa tīsarī āvalī bhī udīraṇāke ayogya hai| purupavedakā vaha saṃkrānta pradeśāgra eka āvalī taka vahā~ rahakara punaḥ mānakī dvitīya kṛṣṭise mānakī tṛtīya kṛṣṭimeṃ, tathā saṃjvalana māyākī prathama aura dvitīya kṛṣṭime saṃkrānta
* tāmrapatravālī pratimeṃ isase āge 'chasu āvaliyāsu gadāsu udīraṇā tti' itanā ṭīkāśa bhī sūtrarūpa se mudrita hai| (dekho pṛ0 1840-41)

ceva apuvaṃ dvidikhaṃḍayama puvyamaṇubhāgakhaṃḍayaṃ dvidibaṃdho ca patthido | 168. jahā 'sayavedo ucasāmido teṇeva kameṇa itthivedaṃ pi guṇaseḍīe uvasāmedi | 169. itthavedassa uvasāmaṇaddhāe saṃkhejjadibhāge| gade tado ṇāṇāvaraṇīya daṃsaṇāvaraṇīya-aṃtarāiyāṇaṃ saṃkhejjavassa-ṭṭhidigo vaṃdho bhavadi | 170. jādhe saṃkhejjavassa - vidio vadho, tassamae ceva edāsiṃ tinhaṃ mūlapayaḍīṇaṃ kevalaṇāṇāvaraṇa - kevaladaṃsaṇāvaraṇavajjāo sesāo jāo uttarapayaḍīo tāsimegaṭṭhāṇio baṃdho | 171. jatto pāe ṇāṇāvaraṇadaṃsaṇāvaraṇa- aṃtarāiyāṇaṃ saṃkhejjavassavidio baṃdho tamhi puṇṇe jo aṇṇo dvidibaṃdho so saṃkhejjaguṇahīṇo | 172. tamhi samae savvakammāṇamappābahuaṃ bhavadi | 173 taṃ jahā | 174. mohaṇīyassa savvatthovo dvidibaṃdho | 175. ṇāṇāvaraṇa- daṃsaṇāvaraṇa-aṃtarāiyāṇaṃ ḍidibaṃdho saṃkhejjaguṇo | 176. gāmā-godāṇaṃ dvidibaṃdho asaṃkhejjaguṇo | 177. vedaṇīyassa dibaṃdha visesāhio | 178. edeṇa kameṇa saṃkhejjesu ṭṭhidibaṃdha sahassesu gade itthavedo uvasāmijjamāṇo uvasāmido |
apūrva anubhāgakāṃḍaka aura apūrva sthitibandha prārambha hotā hai | jisa kramase napuṃsaka vedakā upaśamana kiyā hai, usī kramase guṇaśreṇīke dvārā strīveda ko bhī upaśamātā hai | trīvedake upaśamanakālake saṃkhyāta bhāga bīta jānepara tatpaścāt jñānāvaraṇīya, darśanāvaraṇīya aura antarāya karmakā bandha saṃkhyāta varṣakī sthitivālā ho jātā hai | arthāt isa sthalapara ukta karmoṃkā sthitibandha asaṃkhyāta varpase ghaṭakara saṃkhyāta varpa - pramāṇa raha jātā hai | ( kintu śeṣa tīno aghātiyā karmoṃkā sthitibandha aba bhī asaṃkhyāta varṣakā hotā hai | ) jisa samaya saṃkhyāta varṣakī sthitivālā bandha hotā hai, usī samaya hī ina tīno ghātiyā mūla prakṛtiyokī kevalajñānāvaraṇa aura kevaladarśanāvaraṇa prakṛtiyoko choḍa़kara jo śeṣa uttara prakṛtiyā~ hai, unakā eka sthānīya anubhāga bandha hone lagatā hai | jisa sthalapara jñānāvaraṇa, darśanāvaraṇa aura antarāya karmakā saṃkhyāta varṣakī sthitivālā bandha hai, usake pūrṇa honepara jo anya bandha hotā hai, vaha pūrvase saṃkhyātaguṇita hīna hotā hai | ( kintu tīno aghātiyā karmoṃkā abhī bhī asaṃkhyāta varṣa - pramāṇa hī sthitibandha hotā hai | ) usa samaya sarva karmoṃke sthitibandhakā jo alpabahutva hai, vaha isa prakāra hai - mohanīyakā sthitibandha sabase kama hai| isase jñānāvaraṇa, darśanāvaraṇa aura antarāyakā sthitibandha' saṃkhyātaguṇā hai | isase nāma aura gotrakarmakā sthitibandha asaṃkhyātaguṇā hai | isase vedanīya karmakā sthitibandha viśeṣa adhika hai | isa kramase saṃkhyāta sahasra sthitibandhoke bīta jānepara upaśama kiyā jānevālā strīveda upaśamita ho jātā hai ||166-178||

cūrṇisa0-strīvedake upaśama ho jānepara tadanantarakālameṃ śepa sāto nokaṣāyokā upaśāmaka hotā hai, arthāt unakā upaśamana prārambha karatā hai| usī samayame hī anya sthitikāṃḍaka aura anya anubhāgakāṃḍaka ghātake lie grahaṇa karatā hai, tathā anya sthitivandhako vaॉdhatā hai| isa prakāra saṃkhyāta sahasra sthitivandhoke bītane para aura sāto nokapāyoke upaśamanakālakā saṃkhyātavaॉ bhāga bītane para nāma, gotra aura vedanīya, ina tīno aghātiyā karmoṃkā sthitivandha saṃkhyāta varṣoṃkā hone lagatā hai | usa samaya sthitivandhakā alpavahutva isa prakāra hai-mohanīyakā sthitivandha sabase kama hai| isase jñānāvaraṇa, darśanāvaraṇa aura antarāyakā sthitivandha saṃkhyātaguṇā hai| isase nāma aura gotrakā sthitivandha saṃkhyātaguṇā hai | isase vedanīyakā sthitivandha viśeṣa adhika hotā hai ||179-187||

viśeṣārtha-sarvopaśamanāke dvārā samasta kapāyoke sampūrṇa rūpase upaśānta ho jānepara upaśāntakapāyavītarāgake upaśamakāla pūrā hone taka pariṇāmoṃkī viśuddhi eka rūpase avasthita rahatī hai, phira bhī jo yahā~para jina labdhi-kāṃśoke anubhāgodayako vṛddhi, hāni yā avasthita rūpa batalāyā, usakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki matinānāvaraṇa adi cāra nānāvaraṇīya prakṛtiyā~ aura cakṣudarśanāvaraṇādi tīna darśanāvaraṇīya prakṛtiyā~, ye sāta kṣāyopagamika kāṃśa kahalāte haiṃ, kyoki jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇake kṣayopaśamaviśepako labdhi kahate haiṃ | ukta sāta prakṛtiyokā hī kṣayopaśama hotā hai, śepakā nahīṃ, kyoṃki kevalajñānāvaraṇa aura kevaladarśanāvaraṇa ke sarvaghātī honese unakā kṣayopaśama nahīṃ, kintu kṣaya hī hotā hai| ukta sāta labdhi-karmoṃ se eka avadhijñānāvaraṇīya karmako dṛṣṭāntarūpase lekara vṛddhi, hāni aura eka rūpa avasthānakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa karate haiṃ-upaśāntakapāyavītarāgake yadi avadhijñānāvaraṇakā kṣayopaśama nahīṃ hai, to usake anubhāgakā avasthita udaya hotā hai, kyoki vahā~ para usakī anavasthitatākā koī kāraṇa nahīṃ pāyā jātā hai| yadi upaśāntakapāyavītarāgake avadhi. jñānāvaraṇa karmakā kṣayopaśama hai, to vahaॉpara chaha prakāra kī vṛddhirūpa, yā hānirūpa yā avasthitarūpa anubhāgakā udaya pāyā jāyagā| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki deśāvadhi aura paramāvadhi jñānavāle jīvoke avadhijñānāvaraṇa karmakā jo kṣayopaśama hotā hai, usake asaṃkhyāta lokapramāṇa bheda hote haiṃ, ataeva vāhya aura antaraṃga kāraṇokī apekṣāse unake pariṇāma vṛddhi, hāni yā avasthitarūpa pāye jāte haiṃ| arthāt avadhijñānāvaraṇake sarvotkṛṣṭa kṣayopaśamase pariṇata sarvāvadhijñānīke avadhijñānāvaraṇakā avasthita anubhāgodaya pāyā jāyagā| tathā deśāvadhi aura paramāvadhi jñānavāloke kṣayopaśamake prakarṣāprakarpase vṛddhi yā hānirūpa anubhāgodaya pāyā jāyagā| jo, bāta avadhijñānāvaraṇake viṣayame kahī gaī hai, vahī bāta śepa labdhikarmoṃ ke vṛddhi, hāni yā avasthita anubhāgodayake cipayame bhī āgamāvirodhase lagā lenā cāhie |,

kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [ 14 cāritramoha-upaśāmanādhikāra ti vi savvakaraṇovasāmaṇā' ttivi | 303. desakaraṇovasāmaṇāe duve ṇāmāṇidesakaraṇovasāmaṇāti vi appasatya- uvasāmaṇā ttivi | 304. esā kammapayaḍīsu | 205 jā sā savvakaraṇovasāmaṇā tisse vi dave ṇāmāṇi savvakaraṇotrasāmaṇā ci vipasatyakaraṇovasāmaṇā vivi | 306. edāe etya payadaṃ |
sarvakaraṇopaśāmanā | deśakaraṇīpaśāmanā ke do nāma hai- deśakaragopaśāmanā aura amaṇastopaśāmanā | yaha deśakaraṇopaśāmanā kammapayaṭī (karmaprakṛtiprābhṛta) nāmaka grantha meṃ vistāra se varṇana kī gaī hai | jo sarvakaraṇopaśāmanā hai, usake bhī do nāma haiṃ- sarvakaraṇopaśāmanā aura praśastakaraṇopaśāmanā | grahaॉpara isa sarvakaraṇopaśāmanāme hī prayojana hai | ( isa prakāra yaha 'upaśāmanā kitane prakāra kī hai| isa prathama padakī vibhāṣā samāpta huī | ) || 297 - 306 ||
viśeṣārtha - udaya, udīraṇā ādi pariṇāmoṃke cinā karmoṃ ke upajñāntarūpase avasthānako upaśāmanā kahate haiṃ| usake karaṇa aura akaraṇake bhedase do bheda haiṃ | praśasta aura aprasta pariṇāma dvārā karmapradeśakā upaśāntabhāvame rahanā karaṇopaśāmanā hai | athavā karaṇīkī upaśāmanāko karopaśāmanā kahate haiṃ | arthāta nidhatti, nikācita ādi āṭha karaṇokā praśasta-upaśāmanāke dvārā upaśānta karaneko karaṇopaśāmanā kahate haiṃ| isase bhinna lakṣaṇa vālī akaraṇopaśāmanā hotī hai | arthāt praśasta apraśasta pariṇāma ke vinā hī aprāptakālavāle karma- pradeśakā rūpa pariṇāmake vinā avasthita karaneko akaraṇopaśāmanā kahate haiṃ| imīkā dūsarā nāma anudīrṇopaśāmanā hai | isakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa yaha hai ki dravya, kṣetra, kāla, bhāvakā āśraya lekara karmoṃke honevāle vipāka-pariṇāmako udaya kahate haiṃ | isa prakāra ke udayase pariṇata karmako 'udīrṇa' kahate haiṃ | isa udīrṇa dagāse bhinna arthāt udayāvasthāko nahīṃ prāpta hue karmako 'anudīrṇa' kahate haiṃ | isa prakārake anudīrṇa karmakī upaśāmanāko anudīrṇopaśāmanā kahate haiṃ | isa anudīrṇopaśāmanāme karaṇa - pariṇāmokī apekṣā nahīṃ hotī hai, isalie ise akaraṇopaśāmanā bhī kahate haiṃ | isa akaraṇopaśāmanākā vistṛta varṇana karmapravāda nāmaka āṭhaveṃ pūrvame kiyā gayā hai | karaṇopaśāmanāke bhī do bheda haiṃ- deśakaraṇopaśāmanā aura sarvakaraṇopaśāmanā | apraśastopaśāmanādi karaṇoke dvārā karmapradeśoke eka deśa upaśānta karaneko deśa karaṇopaśāmanā kahate haiṃ | kucha ācārya isakā aisā bhī artha karate haiṃ ki darśanamohanīyakarmake upaśamita ho jānepara apraśastopaśāmanā, nidhatti, nikācita, bandhana, utkarṣaṇa, udīraṇā aura udaya ye sāta karaṇa upaśānta ho jāte haiṃ, tathā apakarṣaṇa aura paraprakṛtisaṃkramaṇa

cūrṇim 0 - tatpaścāt anantara samayame tīna prakārake mānakā apakarṣaṇa karake saṃjvalanamānakī udayādi guṇaśreṇī karatā hai| do prakāra ke mānakī udayāvalī ke bāhira guṇa - śreṇī karatā hai | apratyākhyānāvaraṇa, pratyākhyānāvaraṇa aura saṃjvalanasambandhī lobha, māyā aura mānarūpa nau prakārakī kapāyakā guṇaśreṇīnikṣepa hotā hai | śreṇīse nīce giranevāle usa jīvakā jo mānavedakakāla hai, usase viśeṣa adhika nikṣepa hotā hai | mohanīyako choḍa़kara śepa karmoṃkā jo nikṣepa prathamasamayavartī sūkṣmasāmparāyikake dvārā nikṣipta kiyā gayā hai, usake śepa śepa nikṣepaṇa karatā hai | prathamasamayavartī mānavedakake navo prakārakā kapāya saṃkramaṇako prāpta hotā hai | usa samaya tīna saṃjvalanokā sthitibandha pūre cāra māsa hotā hai | śeṣa karmoṃkā sthitibandha saṃkhyāta sahasra varṣapramāṇa hotā hai | isa prakāra bahutase sthitivandha - sahasra vyatīta hote haiṃ, taba antima samaya meṃ mānakā vedana karanevāle jīvake tīna saṃjvalanokā sthitibandha antarmuhūrta kama āṭha māsa hotā hai aura śeṣa karmoṃkā sthitibandha saṃkhyāta sahasra varṣa pramāṇa hotā hai | tadanantarakālame tīna prakārake krodhakā apakarṣaṇa karake saṃcalanakodhakī udayādi-guṇaśreṇī karatā hai | apratyākhyānāvaraṇa aura pratyākhyānāvaraṇa, ina dono prakārake krodhī udayāvalīke bāhira guṇaśreṇī karatā hai || 433-443||

cūrṇisū0-jisa prakāra mohanīyakarmako choḍa़kara śeṣa karmoṃkī guṇaśreṇīko śepa śeṣame nikṣepaṇa karatā hai usī prakāra yahā~se lekara bāraha kaṣāyokī guṇaśraṇī śeṣa śepame nikṣepaṇa karanā cāhie| prathamasamayavartī krodhavedakake bāraha prakārake kaṣāyakā saṃkramaṇa hotā hai| usa samaya cāro saṃjvalanoṃkā sthitibandha pūre āṭha māsa hai| śeṣa karmoṃkā sthitibandha saṃkhyāta sahasra varpa hai| isa kramase saṃkhyāta sahasra sthitibandhoṃke bīta jānepara mohanīyake caturvidha bandhakā antima samayavartī bandhaka hotā hai| usa samaya mohanīyakā sthitivandha antarmuhūrta kama causaṭha varṣa hai | śeṣa karmoṃkā sthitivandha saṃkhyāta sahasra varṣa hai ||446-452||
cūrṇisū0- tadanantara kālameṃ vaha purupavedakā vandhaka ho jātā hai| usī samayame hī sāta koṃkā sarva pradeśāgra praśastopaśāmanāse anupaśānta ho jātā hai| usa samaya hāsyādi sāta kāṃśokā apakarpaṇa karake puruṣavedakī udyādi-guṇaśreṇīko karatā hai aura śeṣa chaha karmāśoṃkī udayāvalīke bāhira guṇaśreṇī karatā hai| bāraha kapāya aura sāta nokapāyavedanīyokā guṇaśreṇīnikṣepa āyukarmako choḍa़kara śepa karmoṃke guṇaśroṇī-nikṣepake tulya

___ śaṃkā-'jinakī apavartanā hotī hai| isa vākya-dvārā pragaṭa kī gaī yaha apavartanā saṃjñā kisakī hai ? ||285||
samādhāna-jina karmoṃ ke deśaghātī spardhaka hote haiṃ, una karmo kī 'apavartanā' yaha saṃjñā hai ||286||
cūrṇisū0-isa saṃjñāke dvārā jina sarvāvaraṇīya arthāt sarvaghātiyā jñānāvaraṇīya, darśanāvaraṇīya karmokī apavartanā hotī hai, isa padakī vibhāpā kī gaī | vaha isa prakāra haijina karmoṃke deśaghātī spardhaka hote haiṃ, una sarvaghātiyā karmo ko nahīṃ vaॉdhatā hai, kintu deśaghātiyā karmo ko baॉdhatā hai | jaise-matijñānāvaraṇādi cāra jñānāvaraṇa, cakṣudarśanāvaraṇādi cāra darśanāvaraṇa aura paॉca prakārakā antarāya, ina deśaghātiyā karmo ko vaॉdhatā hai||287-291||

viśeṣārtha-yaha pāṃcavīṃ bhāṣyagāthā badhyamāna prakṛtiyome saṃkramaṇa kiye jānevālī badhyamāna yā avadhyamāna prakṛtiyokā kisa prakārase saṃkramaṇa hotā hai, isa arthaviśeṣake batalāneke lie avatīrṇa huī hai| isake arthakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa isa prakāra hai-jhapakaśreṇīmeṃ athavā usase pūrva saṃsārāvasthāmeṃ vartamāna jo jīva jisa vivakṣita prakṛtike karma-pradeśoṃko utkīrṇa kara jisa prakṛtime saṃkramaṇa karatā hai, use kyā vinā kisī viśeṣatāke sarvasthitiyoṃme saṃkramaṇa karatā hai, athavā usame koī viśeṣatā hai, isa prakārakī śaṃkāke samādhānake lie granthakārane gāthākā yaha dvitīya caraṇa kahā ki 'niyamase vandha-sadṛśame saṃkrānta karatā hai|' yahaॉpara 'vandha' isa padase sāmpratika bandhakī agrasthitikā grahaṇa karanā cāhie, kyoki sthitivandhake prati usakī hī pradhānatā hai | ataeva yaha artha hotā hai ki isa samaya baṃdhanevālī prakṛtikī jo sthiti haiṃ, usame usake samāna pramāṇavālī vivakṣita saṃkramyamāṇa prakṛti ke pradeśāgrako utkīrṇa kara saṃkrānta karatā hai| yaha kathana utkarpaṇasaṃkramaṇakī pradhānatāse kiyā gayā hai| 'vaṃdheṇa hīṇadarage' isa tīsare caraṇakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki baṃdhanevālī agrasthitise eka samaya ādi phama adhastana vandhasthitiyome bhī-jo ki āvādhākālase bāhira sthita haiṃ-adhastana pradeśāgrako svasthāna yā parasthānase utkīrṇa kara saṃkramaṇa karatā hai | kintu vartamāname baṃdhanevālī sthitise uparima sattva-sthitiyoṃmeṃ utkarṣaṇasaṃkramaṇa nahīṃ hotā hai, yaha 'ahie vā saṃkamo ṇatthi' isa caturtha caraṇakā artha hai | yahaॉpara paṭhita 'vā' śabda samuñcayārthaka hai, ataeva vandhase hīnatara kisī bhī sthitiviśeṣameṃ utkarṣaṇasaṃkramaṇa nahīṃ hotā hai, aisā artha karanā cāhie, kyoṃki, āvādhākālake bhītarakī sthitiyoṃmeṃ baddha prathama nipekase hīnatara sthitiyome utkarṣaṇasaṃkramaṇakā sarvathā abhāva mānā gayā hai| ataeva āvādhākālakā ullaṃghana karake navakavaddha samayapravaddhake prathama niṣekako ādi lekara navakavaddha samayaprabaddhakī antima sthiti takakī sthitiyomeṃ utkarpaṇasaṃkramaṇakā pratipedha nahīṃ hai, kintu isase ūparakī sthitiyorme aura āvādhākālakī bhītarī sthitiyomeṃ utkarpaṇasaṃkramaṇa nahīṃ hotā hai| paraprakṛtirūpa saṃkramaṇa to samasthitimeṃ pravṛtta hotā huā vadhyamāna prakṛtike kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [15 cāritramoha-kṣapaṇādhikāra 469. etto cautthīe bhāsagāhāe samukttiṇā||
viśeṣārtha-upayukta bhāṣyagāthā utkarpaṇa-apakarṣaṇa-sambandhī alpavahutvake pramāṇakā nirdeśa karatī hai| isakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki kṣapaka yā upaśāmaka jīvoṃmeṃ jisa kisī bhī sthitiviśeṣakā utkarṣaṇa kiyā jānevālā pradeśāgra kama hotā hai aura isase apakarṣaṇa kiyā jānevālā pradeśāgra asaṃkhyātaguṇā hotā hai, kyoki sthiti-apakarṣaṇake samaya viśuddhi pradhāna hai, arthāt uttarottara baḍha़tī jātī hai| apakarṣaṇa kiye jānevāle pradeśāgrase avasthānarūpa rahanevālā arthāt utkarpaṇa-apakarṣaṇake vinā svasthānameṃ hī avasthita pradeśāgra asaṃkhyātaguṇā hotā hai| isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki jisa kisī eka sthitike yā nānā sthitiyoṃke pradeśāgrameṃ palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgakā bhāga denepara eka bhāgapramāṇa pradeśāgra to utkarṣaṇako prāpta hote haiṃ aura śeṣa bahubhāga pradeśokā apakarṣaṇa kiyā jātā hai, ataḥ unakā asaṃkhyātaguṇā honā svābhāvika hī hai| kintu jina svasthāna-sthita asaṃkhyāta vahubhāga-pramāṇa pradeśokā utkarṣaṇa-apakarṣaṇa hī nahīṃ hotā hai aura isīlie jinakī 'avasthāna' yaha saṃjñā hai, ve pradeśāgra apakarṣaṇa kiye jānevāle pradeśāgrase bhī asaṃkhyātaguṇita hote haiṃ, ataḥ unhe isa alpabahutvameṃ asaṃkhyātaguṇā vatalāyā gayā hai| yaha alpavahutva upaśāmaka yā kṣapakakī apekṣā kahā gayā hai| isase nīce saṃsārāvasthāke arthāt sātaveṃ guṇasthāna takake jīvoke utkarpaṇa-apakarṣaṇasamvandhī alpabahutvameṃ bheda hai | jo ki isa prakāra hai-akṣapaka yā anupaśāmaka jīvoke vṛddhi yā utkarṣaṇakī apekṣā hāni yā apakarṣaṇa kadācit tulya bhī hotā hai, kadācit viśeṣa adhika bhī hotā hai aura kadācit viśeṣa hīna bhī ho sakatā hai| kintu avasthāna asaṃkhyātaguṇita hī hotā hai | isakā abhiprāya yaha hai ki mithyādṛṣṭise lekara apramattasaṃyata taka sabhī jīvoke eka yā nānā sthitikī apekṣā prakṛta alpabahutvake karanepara palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāga bhāgahārase gṛhīta pradeśāgrakā yadi saṃkleśa-viśuddhi-rahita madhyama pariṇāma kāraṇa hotā hai to nīce yā ūpara niṣicyamāna utkarṣaṇa-apakarṣaṇarūpa dravya sadṛśa hī hotā hai, kyoki usameṃ visaśatākā koī kāraṇa hī nahīṃ pāyā jātā hai| yadi pariṇāma viśuddha hote haiṃ to nīce apakarṣaṇa kiyā jānevālā dravya adhika hotā hai aura ūpara utkarpaṇa kiyā jānevālā dravya alpa hotā hai| aura yadi pariṇāma saṃkliṣṭa hote haiṃ, to ūpara niṣicyamāna dravya bahuta hotā hai aura nīce apakarpaṇa kiye jānevālā dravya alpa hotā hai| isalie yaha kahā gayā hai ki vṛddhise hāni kadācit sahaśa bhī pāī jātī hai, kadācit viśeṣa adhika aura kadācit viśeṣa hīna bhī| isī prakārakā krama hānise vṛddhimeṃ bhī jānanā cāhie | yahaॉpara vṛddhi yā hānike hīna yā adhikakā pramāṇa asaṃkhyātabhāgamātra hī jānanā cāhie | kintu avasthāna niyamase asaṃkhyātaguṇā hī hotā hai; kyoki, usameṃ dūsarā prakāra saṃbhava hī nahīṃ hai | haॉ, yahā~ itanā viśeṣa avaśya hai ki karaṇa-pariṇāmoke abhimukha jīvake apakarṣaṇarūpa kiye jānevāle dravyase utkarpaṇarūpa dravya asaṃkhyātaguṇā hotā hai | na cūrṇisa0-ava isase āge cauthī bhāṣyagāthākī samutkīrtanā kī jātī hai ||469||

devādi gatiyomeṃ sāgaropama-śatapṛthaktvakāla taka paribhramaṇa kara kṣapakaśreṇīpara caḍha़tā hai, usake bhī tirtha - ggatimeṃ saṃcaya kiyā huā karma niyamase pāyā jātā hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki tiryaggatimeṃ upārjita karmasthitipramāṇa saṃcayakā sāgaropamaśatapṛthaktvakāla ke bhītara sarvathā nirjīrṇa honā asaṃbhava hai | isa prakāra jahā~ kahīṃ bhī karmasthiti -pra - pramāṇakāla taka raha kara āye hue kṣapakake manuṣyagati-upārjita pūrvabhava saṃcita karmakā sadbhāva niyamase pāyā jātā hai | isa kāraṇa 'do gatiyomeṃ pūrvavaddha karma abhajitavya' kahe gaye haiṃ | kintu kṛṣṭivedaka kṣapakake devagati - upārjita aura narakagati - upārjita pūrvabaddha karmakā saṃcaya bhajitavya kahā gayā hai | isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki deva yā narakagatise ākara tiryaṃca yā manuṣyome hī karmasthitipramāṇa kāla taka rahakara tadanantara kṣapakaśreṇīpara caḍha़nevāle jīvake devagati - upārjita aura narakagati - upārjita karma niyama- ' se nahīṃ hotā hai | tathā jo deva - nārakiyoṃme utpanna hokara aura vahaॉ kitane hī kāla taka rahakara tadanantara tiyaṃcome utpanna hokara vahā~ karmasthiti - pramita yā usase adhika kāla taka rahakara aura vahā~ naraka-devagati - saṃcita karmapuṃjako galākara tatpaścāt manuṣyo meṃ utpanna hokara kṣapakaśra eṇīpara caḍha़tā hai, usake bhī naraka aura devagatime upārjita pūrvavaddha karmakā eka bhī paramāṇu nahī pāyā jātā, kyoki, karmasthitikāla vyatīta ho jāneke paścāt usase pahale bā~dhe hue karmake saṃcayakā rahanā asaṃbhava hai | kintu jo naraka aura devagatimai praveśa karake vahā~ kucha kāla taka rahakara aura phira vahā~se nikalakara karmasthitipramita kālake bhītara hī usa pūrvopārjita karmasaṃcayake naṣṭa hue vinā hī kṣapakaśreṇīpara caḍha़tā hai, usake narakagati saṃcita aura devagatisaṃcita karma niyamase pāyā jātā hai, kyoki vaha pūrva-: -bhava-saṃcita karmake galāye vinā hī kṣapakaśreṇīpara caḍha़ā hai | isa prakāra deva aura narakagati-saṃcita pūrvavaddha karmakī bhajanīyatā siddha ho jātī hai | jisaprakāra gatimārgaṇākī apekṣāse pūrvabaddha karma-saṃcayake astitvanāstitvakā vicāra kiyā gayā hai, isī prakāra indriya aura kāyamārgaṇākā āśraya lekarake bhī pūrvavaddha saṃcita karmakī bhajanīyatā - abhajanīyatākā nirṇaya kara lenā cāhie | trasakāyiko - me itanī bāta viśeṣa jānanā cāhie ki saṃjñipaṃcendriya jīvome samupārjita pūrvavaddha karma bhajanīya nahī hai, kintu dvīndriya, trīndriya, caturindriya aura asaṃjñipaṃcendriyome tathā labdhyaparyāptaka-saṃjñipaṃcendriyoṃmeṃ pūrvavaddha karma bhajanīya hī haiṃ, aisā nayadhavalākārakā kahanā hai | jahā~ jina pūrvavaddha karmoṃkī saṃbhavatā hai, vahā~ unake eka paramāṇuko ādi lekara anantakarma-paramāṇuo takakā astitva saṃbhava hai, aura jahā~ jinakī saṃbhavatā nahī hai, vahā~ unake eka bhī paramāṇukā astitva śeṣa nahīṃ samajhanā cāhie |

kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [15 cāritramoha-kṣapaṇādhikāra avavaddhasesāṇi | 978. paḍamāe gāhāe attho samatto bhavadi | 979. javamajha kāyavvaṃ, vissaridaṃ lihidu| śepa jānanā cāhie| isa prakāra prathama bhāpyagāthākā artha samāpta ho jātā hai | yahaॉpara yavamadhyakī prarūpaṇā karanā cāhie | ( pahale kṣapakaprāyogyaprarūpaṇāke avasarameṃ ) hama likhanā bhūla gaye ||976-979||
viśepārtha-abhavyasiddhoṃke yogya kī jānevālī isa prarūpaṇāmeṃ prathama bhāṣyagāthākī vibhāpā karate hue yavamadhyakī prarūpaṇā karanā āvaśyaka hai| kṣapaka-prāyogyaprarūpaṇāme bhī isa yavamadhyaprarūpaṇākā kiyā jānā āvaśyaka thā, para cūrṇikāra kahate haiṃ, ki vahaॉpara hama likhanā bhūla gaye, isalie yahaॉpara usakī sūcanā kara rahe haiṃ| vaha isa prakāra jānanā cāhie-atītakālakī apekṣā eka jīvake eka sthitiviśeṣame eka-eka rūpase rahakara udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita hue jo samayapravaddha-śepa hai, ye ananta hokara bhī vakṣyamāṇa samayapravaddhokī apekṣā sabase kama hai| punaḥ do doke rūpameṃ rahakara udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita hue jo samayaprabaddha-śepa hai, ve viśepa adhika hai| tīna-tīnake rūpame rahakara udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita hue jo samayaprabaddha-śeṣa haiṃ, ve viśepa adhika haiṃ| isa prakāra cāra, paॉca ādike kramase baḍha़kara palyopamakā asaṃkhyātavaॉ bhāga prāpta hone taka eka sthitiviśeṣameṃ rahakara aura udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita hue samayaprabaddha-śeṣa dugune hote haiṃ| punaḥ palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramita viśeṣa adhika sthāna jānepara udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita honevāle samayaprabaddhaśeṣa dugune prāpta hote haiṃ| isa prakāra palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramita duguṇa vṛddhiyoṃke vyatīta honepara samayaprabaddha-śepokī vṛddhikā yavamadhya prāpta hotā hai | usa yavamadhyase ūpara sarvatra viśepahīnake kramase sthāna prāpta hote haiṃ| samayapravaddha-śepoke ye viśeṣahīna sthāna taba taka prāpta hote hue cale jāte haiṃ, jaba taka ki palyopamakā utkṛṣṭa asaṃkhyātavaॉ bhāga na prāpta ho jāya | samayapravaddha-śepokī yavamadhyaprarūpaṇāke samāna bhavavaddha-śepokī bhī yavamadhyaprarūpaṇā karanā cāhie| kitane hī ācārya isa yavamadhyaprarūpaṇākā nānā sthitiviśeṣoko āśraya lekarake vyākhyāna karate hai| unakā kahanā hai ki eka sthitiviśepame śeṣarūpase rahakara apavartanāke dvārā udayako prāpta hokara nirlepanabhāvako prāpta honevāle samayaprabaddha thoḍa़e hai| do sthitiviśeṣome śeṣarūpase rahakara apavartanāke vaśase udayako prāpta hokara nirlepita honevāle samayapravaddha viśeṣa adhika hai| isa prakāra viśeṣa adhikake kramase tīna, cāra ādiko lekara palyopamake asaṃkhyātave bhāgapramita sthitiviśeṣomeṃ śeṣarūpase rahakara apavartanāke vaśase udayako prāpta kara nirlepanaparyāyako prāpta honevāle samayaprabaddhokī śalākāe~ dugunī hotī haiṃ | isa isa vyākhyānako asamīcīna ṭhaharāte hai | unakā kahanā hai ki prathama bhāṣyagāthā ekasthitiviśeṣa-viṣayaka hai, usa samaya nānāsthiti-viṣayaka samayaprabaddhaśeṣokī prarūpaṇā

kasāya pāhuḍa sutta [ paścimaskandha-arthādhikāra 50. samucchiṇṇakiriyamaṇiyaṭṭisukkajhāṇaṃ jhāyadi | 51. selesiṃ addhāe jhīṇāe savyakammavippamukko egasamaeṇa siddhiṃ gacchaī | 52. khavaṇadaṃḍao samatto |
pacchimakkhaṃdho atthāhiyāro samatto | prāpta hote haiṃ, arthāt caudahaveṃ ayogikevalī guṇasthāname praveśa karate hai | usa samaya unake aṭhāraha hajāra śīlake bheda aura caurāsī lākha uttara guṇa paripūrṇatāko prāpta ho jāte haiṃ | yadyapi ukta śīla aura uttara guṇokī pūrṇatā sayogijinake bhī mānī jātī hai, para yogake sānnidhyase vahā~ pūrṇa saṃvara nahīṃ hai, ataḥ paramopekṣālakṣṇa yathākhyāta-vihāraśuddhi saṃyamakī carama sīmā yoganirodha honepara hī saṃbhava hai | 'selesiṃ' isa prākṛtapadakā 'śaileśī' aisā saṃskṛtarūpa mānakara kucha ācārya isakā yaha bhī artha karate haiṃ ki śaila arthāt parvatokā īśa sumeru jaise sarvadā acala, akaṃpa rahatā hai, usī prakāra yogakā abhāva ho jānese ayogijinakī avasthā ekadama śānta, sthira aura akaṃpa ho jātī hai | isa śaileśī avasthākā kāla paṃca hrasva akṣaroke uccāraṇakāla-pramāṇa hai |
cūrṇisū0-usa samaya śaileśya avasthāko prāpta ayogikevalī jina samucchinnakriyānivṛtti nāmaka caturtha śukladhyānako dhyāte haiṃ| śaileśyakālake kṣīṇa ho jāne para sarva karmoṃse vipramukta hokara eka samayame siddhiko prāpta ho jāte haiṃ ||50-51||
